cves.d: CordysCRM through 1.9.3 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to skip permission checks by setting the owner field to their own user id. Attackers can send requests to the follow/record/add endpoints to add follow-up records and overwrite follow_time and follower on any known customer, clue or opportunity.

mall4j through 4.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated storefront customers to delete other shoppers' cart items through an operator precedence error in the cleanExpiryProdList SQL statement. Attackers can send one DELETE request to /p/shopCart/cleanExpiryProdList to remove every user's cart entries for off-shelf products, which do not return when products are restocked.

JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the sendBusAnnouncement handler of SystemApiController that allows any authenticated user to send announcements without the required permissions. Low-privileged attackers can POST crafted bodies to /sys/api/sendBusAnnouncement with forged sender, recipients, title and content to deliver spoofed admin or system messages for phishing.

JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the SysCategoryController delete handler that allows any authenticated user to delete category dictionary nodes. Low-privileged attackers can obtain node ids from the unguarded rootList and childList endpoints and delete entire sys_category subtrees, breaking dependent forms and dictionary fields.

zotero-mcp 0.10.0 through 0.14.1 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows attackers to reach internal services because _fetch_embedded_metadata fetches URLs without destination validation. Attackers can steer the agent via prompt injection into calling zotero_add_by_url, causing requests to loopback, private, or link-local hosts directly or via redirects, leaking citation meta-tags and error details.

A weakness has been identified in macrozheng mall up to 1.0.3. This vulnerability affects the function OmsPortalOrderServiceImpl of the file /order/generateOrder of the component mall-portal. This manipulation of the argument coupon_amount/pay_amount causes business logic errors. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The vendor deleted the GitHub issue for this vulnerability without any explanation.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

perf/x86/intel/pt: Fix stop/start with no update

If pt_event_stop() is called without PERF_EF_UPDATE flag, then
perf_aux_output_end() is not called.  A subsequent call to pt_event_start()
will call perf_aux_output_begin() again which violates the rule against
nesting and triggers a WARNING in perf_aux_output_begin().

Originally, pt_event_stop() was never called without PERF_EF_UPDATE,
because the only code paths to do so are from event overflow, and Intel PT
does not do that.

However the introduction of group throttling by commit 9734e25fbf5ae
("perf: Fix the throttle logic for a group") meant that an Intel PT event
could be throttled if it was part of a group.  Throttling calls PMU
 ->stop() / ->start() callbacks without flags.

An example is when AUX area sampling is used. The following commands
hit the issue:

  echo 10000 > /proc/sys/kernel/perf_event_max_sample_rate

  perf record -F32000 --aux-sample -e '{intel_pt//u,cycles:u}' \
  -- bash -c 'for i in `seq 1 100000` ; do true ; done'

Use PERF_HES_UPTODATE to track whether perf_aux_output_begin() and
perf_aux_output_end() are balanced.  A cleared PERF_HES_UPTODATE bit
indicates that an AUX output context is still open.

Amend pt_event_start() / pt_event_stop() accordingly so that begin/end
stay balanced:

 - In non-snapshot mode, stop() always closes the buffer (the buffer may
   have run out of space, and that accounting is done by the update), so
   a following start() opens a fresh one as before.

 - In snapshot/overwrite mode, stop() without PERF_EF_UPDATE leaves the
   buffer open so that pt_event_snapshot_aux() can still copy from it,
   and start() then only re-enables tracing instead of calling
   perf_aux_output_begin() again.

Note that pt_event_del() calls pt_event_stop() with PERF_EF_UPDATE flag set
(as is required by the documentation), so a final call to
perf_aux_output_end() is assured.

JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the embeddingSearch handler of AiragKnowledgeController that lacks Shiro permission annotations. Low-privileged authenticated attackers can supply knowledge base ids to the GET /airag/knowledge/embedding/search endpoint to read document text chunks from unauthorized knowledge bases.

JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the AiragPromptsController queryById handler that allows low-privileged authenticated users to read any AI prompt template. Attackers can enumerate ids via the unguarded /airag/prompts/list endpoint and query each one to obtain prompt text, model parameters, and creator details belonging to administrators or other users.

JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the SysTenantController listPackByTenantUserId handler that allows any authenticated user to query tenant product packs. Low-privileged attackers can supply arbitrary tenantId and userId parameters to enumerate any tenant's product pack configuration and reveal which users are tenant administrators.

JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the OssFileController queryById handler that allows low-privileged authenticated users to read object storage file records. Attackers who know a record id can request GET /sys/oss/file/queryById to obtain original file names and direct storage URLs of files uploaded by other users.

JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the queryUserRolesById handler of SystemApiController that lets authenticated users read any user's role codes. Low-privileged attackers can send a userId to GET /sys/api/queryUserRolesById to enumerate role assignments and identify administrator accounts.

JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to permanently delete data dictionaries via the deletePhysic handler of SysDictController. Low-privileged attackers can send DELETE requests to /sys/dict/deletePhysic/{id} to irreversibly remove active dictionaries and all their items, bypassing the recycle bin.

A SQL injection vulnerability has been identified in Payload CMS. Improper neutralization of input provided by user into "in" and "not_in" query paramethers allows an authenticated attacker to perform SQL Injection attacks.

This issue was fixed in version 3.90.0 and 4.0.0-canary.34.

JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to delete department permission bindings via the DELETE /sys/sysDepartPermission/deleteBatch endpoint. Attackers can obtain row ids from the unguarded list endpoint and submit them in the ids parameter to remove menus and buttons departments can grant to their roles.

NVIDIA DALI contains a vulnerability where an attacker could cause an uncontrolled out-of-bounds read. A successful exploit of this vulnerability mighty lead to information disclosure, data tampering, and denial of service.

NVIDIA DALI contains a vulnerability where an attacker could cause an uncontrolled out-of-bounds write. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to denial of service, information disclosure, and data tampering.

NVIDIA DALI contains a vulnerability where an attacker could cause an uncontrolled out-of-bounds read. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to information disclosure and denial of service.

A security flaw has been discovered in conductor-oss conductor up to 3.33.0-rc10. This affects the function KafkaPublishTask.start of the file kafka/src/main/java/com/netflix/conductor/contribs/tasks/kafka/KafkaPublishTask.java. The manipulation of the argument kafka_request.bootStrapServers results in server-side request forgery. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.

JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the saveDatarule handler of SysDepartPermissionController that allows any authenticated user to modify department data rules. Low-privileged attackers can send departId, permissionId and dataRuleIds to POST /sys/sysDepartPermission/datarule to change, add or clear data rules on any department-menu permission binding.
Zohocorp ManageEngine Malware Protection Plus versions before 1.0.64.12 are affected by insufficient driver signature validation in MEARWService.

JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the SysMessageController deleteBatch handler that allows low-privileged authenticated users to delete message records. Attackers can obtain record ids from the unguarded list endpoint and submit them to deleteBatch to remove any message push records, including pending queued messages.

A low privileged remote attacker is able to view a list of roles that should only be accessible to administrators. This results in a low level of confidentiality breach, as no particularly sensitive information is affected.

JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to delete message templates via the DELETE /sys/message/sysMessageTemplate/deleteBatch endpoint. Attackers can supply comma-separated template ids from the unguarded list endpoint to delete all sys_sms_template rows, breaking template-based notifications such as workflow reminders.

JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the AiragExtDataController exportXls handler that allows any authenticated user to export AI evaluator data. Low-privileged attackers can request /airag/extData/exportXls to download every user's airag_ext_data evaluator definitions and test-tracking records as an Excel workbook.

Firefox for iOS directly interpolated the page’s HTML language attribute into translation JavaScript, allowing attacker-controlled markup to execute code in Firefox’s privileged content world and bypass the page’s Content Security Policy. This vulnerability was fixed in Firefox for iOS 157.1.

A vulnerability was determined in conductor-oss conductor up to 3.32.5. Affected by this vulnerability is the function A2AService.getAgentCard of the file ai/src/main/java/org/conductoross/conductor/ai/a2a/A2AService.java of the component Agent Card Fetching. Executing a manipulation of the argument agentUrl can lead to server-side request forgery. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized.

An incorrect authorization vulnerability in the WinBox
authentication flow of MikroTik RouterOS allows a remote authenticated attacker
with credentials for a low-privilege account permitted to use WinBox to obtain
the authorization policy of a different existing account. The stage-one EC-SRP
challenge and proof are verified using the attacker's account, while the
independently supplied stage-two username is used to install the target
account's privileges. By specifying a higher-privilege account such as admin, a
low-privilege user can obtain a full administrative session without knowing the
target account's password and can use that session to increase the privileges
of the attacker's own account.
IBM Db2 11.5.0 through 11.5.9, and 12.1.0 through 12.1.5 is vulnerable to a local privilege escalation via the db2pd utility.
IBM Db2 11.5.0 through 11.5.9, and 12.1.0 through 12.1.5 is vulnerable to privilege escalation when db2locssh is enabled with the db2 instance.

IBM Db2 11.5.0 through 11.5.9, and 12.1.0 through 12.1.5 for Linux, UNIX and Windows (includes DB2 Connect Server) could allow a local attacker to gain elevated privileges due to improper privilege management.

IBM Db2 Mirror for i 7.4, 7.5, and 7.6 is vulnerable to privilege escalation. An authenticated attacker could craft a malicious request that bypasses additional authorization and input validation checks to execute malicious code. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to obtain elevated privileges on the system.

IBM Power Systems Firmware FW1060.00 through FW1060.81 is affected by a vulnerability in host firmware configuration parsing. An attacker with authenticated service-level access to the FSP can write specially crafted configuration data to cause memory corruption in the host firmware boot stage during system IPL, compromising the host firmware boot stack and the hypervisor subsequently loaded by it. Successful exploitation results in a confidentiality, integrity, and availability impact to the managed system.

IBM Power Systems Firmware FW1060.00 through FW1060.81 is affected by a vulnerability in the service processor mailbox interface. An attacker with authenticated service-level access to the FSP can send a specially crafted mailbox message to read or modify arbitrary regions of Hostboot memory, compromising the host firmware boot stack and the hypervisor subsequently loaded by it. Successful exploitation results in a confidentiality, integrity, and availability impact to the managed system.

IBM Power Systems Firmware FW1060.00 through FW1060.81  is affected by a vulnerability in the service processor mailbox interface. An attacker with authenticated service-level access to the FSP can send a specially crafted mailbox message to overflow host firmware runtime attribute storage, allowing arbitrary code to be executed in the host firmware runtime. This gives the attacker full access to the managed system's memory and hardware interfaces, resulting in a confidentiality, integrity, and availability impact to the managed system.

IBM Power Systems Firmware FW1120.00 through FW1120.01, FW1110.00 through FW1110.31, and FW1060.00 through FW1060.81 is affected by a vulnerability in the host firmware boot process image validation path. An attacker with service access to the service processor can supply a maliciously crafted code update image, allowing arbitrary code to be executed on the host system. Successful exploitation could result in a confidentiality, integrity, and availability impact to the affected host system.

IBM Power Systems Firmware FW1060.00 through FW1060.81 is affected by a vulnerability in the service processor mailbox interface. An attacker with authenticated service-level access to the FSP can send a specially crafted mailbox message to overflow host firmware runtime attribute storage, allowing arbitrary code to be executed in the host firmware runtime. This gives the attacker full access to the managed system's memory and hardware interfaces, resulting in a confidentiality, integrity, and availability impact to the managed system.

JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read other users' AI voice generation history via the userId parameter of GET /airag/voice/listByUser. Attackers who know another user's id can retrieve submitted text-to-speech input, voice settings, timestamps, and generated audio file names and paths stored in Redis.

The WP-BusinessDirectory  WordPress plugin through 4.0.2 does not restrict the type or destination of files saved by an unauthenticated upload handler, allowing unauthenticated attackers to write files with arbitrary content to arbitrary locations, though not to execute code on a default server configuration.

The WP Testimonials WordPress plugin through 1.4.13 does not properly escape testimonial content and reverses WordPress's HTML sanitization when rendering it, allowing users with the Author role and above to store JavaScript that executes in the session of any user viewing the testimonials, including administrators.

Tabularis through 0.27.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the MCP run_query safety gate that allows prompt-injected agents or untrusted MCP clients to bypass read-only mode by submitting side-effecting SELECT statements. Attackers can run statements like SELECT setval, nextval, or PostgreSQL query_to_xml with embedded DELETE to modify data without approval prompts.

A vulnerability was found in conductor-oss conductor 3.22.0. Affected is the function MCPService.listTools of the file ai/src/main/java/org/conductoross/conductor/ai/mcp/MCPService.java of the component MCP Service. Performing a manipulation of the argument mcpServer results in server-side request forgery. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used.

Floci 1.1.0 before 2.2.0 contains a code injection vulnerability in VtlTemplateEngine that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute commands via unrestricted Velocity mapping templates. Attackers can create a REST API with a MOCK integration whose template uses $util reflection to reach Runtime or ProcessBuilder, executing OS commands in the Floci JVM.

9router 0.4.1 through 0.5.99 contains a configuration injection vulnerability in the POST /api/cli-tools/hermes-settings endpoint that allows authenticated dashboard users to inject arbitrary keys into the Hermes Agent config.yaml file. Attackers can submit a baseUrl containing double quotes and newlines to add hooks_auto_accept and a hooks.post_llm_call shell command, which Hermes Agent executes without approval after an LLM call.

PairDrop through 1.11.2 contains an IP spoofing vulnerability in Peer._setIP that allows remote attackers to join other networks' discovery rooms by supplying a forged cf-connecting-ip header. Attackers who know a victim's public IP can appear as a local device on self-hosted instances not behind Cloudflare to send or receive files.

cc-connect through 1.5.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the MAX platform adapter webhook mode in platform/max/max.go that accepts unauthenticated updates when no webhook_secret is configured. Remote attackers reaching the webhook listener on port 8080 can forge updates with an allowed or admin user_id to run privileged commands like /shell on the host.

Kortix Suna 0.10.7 before 0.13.52 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows project managers to bypass the isPrivateIp guard by supplying IPv6 6to4 or Teredo addresses that embed private IPv4 destinations. Attackers holding project.connector.write can set connector base_url, OpenAPI, Postman, or MCP URLs to reach internal services and cloud metadata endpoints and read responses.

Pingvin Share X before 1.22.0 contains a rate limit bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to evade per-IP throttling because backend/src/main.ts unconditionally trusts proxy headers. Attackers can rotate spoofed X-Forwarded-For values against /api/auth/signIn, /api/auth/signIn/totp, and /api/auth/resetPassword to brute-force passwords and TOTP codes and forge logged client IP addresses.

Enclave OS Virtual runs container workloads inside confidential virtual machines with end-to-end attestation. Prior to tdx-v0.2.43 and tdx-gpu-v0.6.27, the TDX/GPU RA-TLS certificate issuer placed the certificate public-key hash and client nonce in quote ReportData but omitted a value bound to the active TLS session. An attacker who obtained an enclave TLS private key could relay a genuine quote onto another connection, causing a relying party to accept an attacker-terminated connection as the attested enclave. This issue is fixed in tdx-v0.2.43 and tdx-gpu-v0.6.27.

A vulnerability has been found in conductor-oss conductor 3.31.2. This affects the function ListApiToolsTask.start of the file ListApiToolsTask.java of the component API Tool Configuration. The manipulation of the argument specUrl leads to server-side request forgery. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.

Enclave OS Mini is a Rust-based runtime for confidential applications inside Intel SGX enclaves. Prior to wasm-v0.40.0, the SGX runtime's RA-TLS challenge certificate path placed the certificate public-key hash and client nonce in quote ReportData but omitted a value bound to the active TLS session. An attacker who obtained an enclave TLS private key could relay a genuine quote onto another connection, causing a relying party to accept an attacker-terminated connection as the attested enclave. This issue is fixed in wasm-v0.40.0.

Tina is a headless content management system. Prior to tinacms 3.14.0 and @tinacms/app 2.5.14, the /~/* admin preview route in packages/tinacms/src/admin/index.tsx can turn an attacker-controlled hash-router splat into an off-origin iframe URL through packages/@tinacms/app/src/preview.tsx, while packages/@tinacms/app/src/lib/preview-origin.ts derives expectedOrigin from that same URL for the GraphQL message channel in packages/@tinacms/app/src/lib/graphql-reducer.ts. An unauthenticated attacker can send a crafted link to a signed-in editor, cause the admin to frame an attacker origin, and have that frame treated as the trusted preview. The attacker-controlled frame can submit GraphQL reads or mutations that the admin executes with the editor credentials, exposing or modifying protected content. This issue is fixed in tinacms 3.14.0 and @tinacms/app 2.5.14.

Cross-Site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in AuthTake Technology Inc. Authtake allows Encryption Brute Forcing.

This issue affects authtake: from v1.3 before v1.4.

CiviForm simplifies applications for government benefits programs by reusing applicant data across multiple benefit applications. Prior to 3.33.0, GET /admin/tiDash/editClientForm/:accountId verifies that the requester is a Trusted Intermediary but showEditClientForm performs a raw lookupAccount(accountId) without confirming that the citizen account belongs to the requester's trustedIntermediaryGroup. An authenticated Trusted Intermediary can enumerate accountId values and read the applicant display name, including the citizen's name and email address, for accounts outside the intermediary's group. This issue is fixed in version 3.33.0.

VideoLAN VLC for Android prior to version 3.7.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the Remote Access Server routing for the authenticated endpoint GET /download. The file query parameter is concatenated into a filesystem path under the configured download directory without canonicalization or directory containment checks, allowing an authenticated attacker with network reachability to the Remote Access Server to request files outside the intended directory. The impact is bounded by the Android application sandbox and storage restrictions, typically limiting exposure to app-internal and app-specific external storage.

VideoLAN VLC for Android prior to version 3.7.0 contains an authentication bypass in the Remote Access Server feature due to missing or insufficient rate limiting on one-time password (OTP) verification. The Remote Access Server uses a 4-digit OTP and does not enforce effective throttling or lockout within the OTP validity window, allowing an attacker with network reachability to the server to repeatedly attempt OTP verification until a valid user_session cookie is issued. Successful exploitation results in unauthorized access to the Remote Access interface, limited to media files explicitly shared by the VLC for Android user.

Lektor 3.3.14 and 3.4.0b15 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the admin API blueprint that allows unauthenticated attackers to perform state-changing actions by sending cross-origin requests without CSRF tokens, Origin/Referer validation, CORS configuration, or Host allowlisting. Attackers can exploit the newattachment, deleterecord, build, clean, and publish endpoints from a malicious web page to write arbitrary files, delete pages, wipe build output, trigger deployment publication, and via DNS rebinding reach read endpoints to disclose data.

Podgrab contains a missing authentication vulnerability in which the /ws WebSocket route is registered on the root gin engine instead of the BasicAuth-protected router group, allowing unauthenticated network clients to connect even when PASSWORD is configured. Attackers can join the allConnections set, capture PlayerExists broadcasts containing client-supplied player identifiers, and replay them in a RegisterPlayer message to hijack queue payloads intended for authenticated users, exposing episode IDs, titles, and server-side file paths while potentially disrupting legitimate playback.

Podgrab contains an unauthenticated denial-of-service vulnerability caused by unsynchronized concurrent access to shared maps (activePlayers and allConnections) in its WebSocket handler, where Wshandler and HandleWebsocketMessages goroutines read and write these maps without a mutex. A remote attacker can open multiple WebSocket connections to the /ws endpoint and send messages in a loop to trigger a Go runtime data race that crashes the process, causing a denial of service that requires operator intervention to restore service.

Contao is an Open Source CMS. From version 4.0.0 until 5.3.50 and 5.7.12, RequestTokenListener validates REQUEST_TOKEN only for POST requests, while the declarative GET guard runs only when an act parameter is present. Backend actions dispatched through the key parameter can therefore execute without a CSRF token when an authenticated backend user loads an attacker-controlled URL. Reachable actions remain limited to modules available to that user, and the advisory demonstrates destructive or state-changing actions rather than privilege escalation. This issue is fixed in versions 5.3.50 and 5.7.12.

A vulnerability was determined in AOMEI Backupper up to 8.3.0. Impacted is an unknown function in the library amwrtdrv.sys of the component Kernel Driver. Executing a manipulation can lead to improper access controls. The attack needs to be launched locally. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A vulnerability was determined in PublicCMS up to 5.202608.a. Affected by this issue is the function SafeConfigComponent.getSafeUrl of the file publiccms-core/src/main/java/com/publiccms/logic/component/config/SafeConfigComponent.java of the component pay Endpoint. Executing a manipulation of the argument returnUrl can lead to open redirect. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.
OpENer v2.3/commit 76b95cf, contains an integer underflow in the server-side EtherNet/IP ForwardOpen connection-path parser. This allows a remote attacker to cause a denial of service

A vulnerability has been identified in RUGGEDCOM CROSSBOW (All versions < V6.0). Affected devices do not properly validate or sanitize input in the Name and Value fields for custom file labels. This could allow an authenticated attacker with administrative privileges to execute arbitrary SQL commands on the underlying database.

A security vulnerability has been detected in jbardin scp.py up to 0.16.1. The impacted element is the function _recv_file/_recv_pushd of the component SCP Receive Handler. The manipulation leads to path traversal. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. Upgrading to version 0.16.2 is sufficient to resolve this issue. The identifier of the patch is 42fc3aaa71411daed60544e3b40179c1038bed5d. Upgrading the affected component is advised. The vendor was contacted early, responded in a very professional manner and quickly released a fixed version of the affected product.

A vulnerability has been identified in RUGGEDCOM CROSSBOW (All versions < V6.0). Affected devices do not properly perform server-side authorization checks for requests to schedule special operations. This could allow an authenticated attacker with minimal privileges to schedule unauthorized operations on devices.

A vulnerability was found in TRENDnet TEW-432BRP 3.10B20. Affected by this vulnerability is the function formTcpipSetup of the file /goform/formTcpipSetup. Performing a manipulation of the argument Name results in stack-based buffer overflow. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The vendor confirms: "As this router was EOL'd in 2011, we have no way of testing if such vulnerability exists. We will notify our customers of a potential vulnerability on this product." This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer.

A flaw was found in RESTEasy's CorsFilter, which, when configured to allow all origins ("*"), reflects the request's Origin header back in the Access-Control-Allow-Origin response together with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true. This permissive cross-origin policy allows a malicious website to make credentialed cross-origin requests and read authenticated responses from a victim's session, resulting in a loss of confidentiality.

cves.d: A flaw was found in RESTEasy's IIOImageProvider, which decodes attacker-supplied image request bodies without enforcing any limit on the declared image dimensions or pixel count. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can send a small crafted image declaring enormous dimensions to trigger a very large memory allocation, exhausting the JVM heap and resulting in a denial of service.

cves.d: A vulnerability has been found in SeldonIO MLServer up to 1.6.1. Affected is the function _extract_env of the file mlserver/env.py of the component environment_tarball Handler. Such manipulation leads to path traversal. The attack may be performed from remote. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A vulnerability was detected in MosaicML Composer up to 0.32.1. This affects the function tarball.extractall of the file composer/utils/checkpoint.py of the component Checkpoint Extraction. The manipulation results in path traversal. The attack can be executed remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.

A weakness has been identified in beautifier js-beautify up to 1.15.1/2.0.3. The affected element is an unknown function. Executing a manipulation can lead to uncontrolled memory allocation. The attack may be launched remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

Forms using FileUpload or ImageUpload elements with a custom saveToFileMount configured stored uploaded files in the default storage folder 1:/user_upload/ instead of the configured destination. This could cause uploaded files to end up in a publicly accessible storage even though a restricted, non-public storage had been configured. Files stored this way are served directly, without the access checks applied to non-public storages. Forms that use the default value for saveToFileMount are not affected. This issue affects TYPO3 CMS versions 14.0.0-14.3.8.

A vulnerability has been identified in APOGEE MBC (PPC) (BACnet) (All versions), APOGEE MBC (PPC) (P2 Ethernet) (All versions), APOGEE MEC (PPC) (BACnet) (All versions), APOGEE MEC (PPC) (P2 Ethernet) (All versions), APOGEE PXC Compact (BACnet) (All versions < V3.5.7), APOGEE PXC Compact (P2 Ethernet) (All versions < V2.8.21), APOGEE PXC Modular (BACnet) (All versions < V3.5.7), APOGEE PXC Modular (P2 Ethernet) (All versions < V2.8.21), TALON TC Compact (BACnet) (All versions < V3.5.7), TALON TC Modular (BACnet) (All versions < V3.5.7). The affected product web service does not properly validate the length of user-controllable input. This could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to read portions of device memory or to cause a denial-of-service condition.

A vulnerability has been identified in RUGGEDCOM CROSSBOW (All versions < V6.0). Affected devices do not properly perform authorization checks for device disconnection requests. This could allow an authenticated attacker with minimal privileges to disconnect active sessions of other users, including administrators, leading to a denial of service.

A vulnerability has been identified in RUGGEDCOM CROSSBOW (All versions < V6.0). Affected devices do not properly validate or sanitize input in device group or facility names processed during the Bulk Export workflow. This could allow an authenticated attacker with specific privileges to execute arbitrary SQL commands on the underlying database.

A vulnerability has been identified in RUGGEDCOM CROSSBOW (All versions < V6.0). Affected devices do not properly validate or sanitize input in the Value field of notification conditions processed during the Notification Profile configuration. This could allow an authenticated attacker with specific privileges to execute arbitrary SQL commands on the underlying database.

A vulnerability has been identified in RUGGEDCOM CROSSBOW (All versions < V6.0). Affected devices do not properly validate or sanitize input in facility names processed during the Bulk Import/Export workflow. This could allow an authenticated attacker with specific privileges to execute arbitrary SQL commands on the underlying database.

A vulnerability has been identified in .NET Client Library for SIMATIC S7 Webserver API (All versions < V3.3.62). Affected applications do not properly redact PLC restore passwords from HTTP error exception messages.

This could allow an attacker with access to logs or other diagnostic output to obtain the plaintext restore password and potentially perform unauthorized operations on the PLC.

A vulnerability has been identified in .NET Client Library for SIMATIC S7 Webserver API (All versions < V3.3.61). Affected applications do not properly validate filenames received from remote servers during ticket downloads.

This could allow an attacker who can manipulate the ticket response to write arbitrary files outside the intended download directory and, when overwriting is enabled, replace existing files accessible to the application.
vp: .net client library for simatic s7 webserver api

cves.d: A vulnerability has been identified in Industrial Edge App Publisher (All versions < V1.27.9). The affected software does not properly validate the server certificate when initiating a TLS connection. This allows an attacker to intercept and relay communication (Man-in-the-Middle attack) and to spoof a trusted entity by interfering in the communication path between the client and the intended server.

A vulnerability has been identified in SIMATIC IPC BX-21A (All versions < V31.01.13), SIMATIC IPC RW-543A (All versions < V1.1.4), SIMATIC IPC227G / IPC277G / IPC277G PRO / IPC327G / IPC377G (All versions < V28.01.15). A BIOS vendor test key is present in the UEFI Secure Boot key database. This could allow a local attacker with physical or administrative access to the device to boot an operating system or UEFI application signed with that test key, bypassing UEFI Secure Boot protections even when Secure Boot is enabled, potentially leading to a full loss of confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the device.

A vulnerability has been identified in SIMATIC WinCC V7.5 (All versions), SIMATIC WinCC V8.0 (All versions < V8.0 Update 11), SIMATIC WinCC V8.1 (All versions < V8.1 Update 7). The affected application does not sufficiently restrict the permissions assigned to a database role.
This could allow an authenticated remote attacker with database access to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary commands on the host system where SIMATIC WinCC is installed, potentially leading to a compromise of the system.

Affected systems do not properly restrict access to internal APIs and paths for authenticated users. This could allow an authenticated remote attacker to access sensitive internal information, which in the worst case could be leveraged to facilitate unauthorized access to the system or result in the deletion of data.

This manipulation of the argument teamId causes improper privilege management. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

This issue might allow attackers to run harmful code in rare configurations without modern protections.

cves.d: A double free issue has been identified in libarchive's RAR5 reader. During parsing of a specially crafted RAR5 archive, the filtered_buf pointer may remain stale after being freed during unpacking state reinitialization. Successful exploitation may cause applications using the vulnerable libarchive API to terminate unexpectedly, leading to a denial of service.

cves.d: The AcyMailing plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the customField[] parameter of the public frontusers::subscribe endpoint in versions up to, and including, 11.1.0. This is due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping in the acym_cleanVar() sanitizer, whose HTML-tag stripper only matches complete tags (requiring a closing '>'), together with SubscriberInsertion::replaceUserInformation() and the archive view template, which substitute the stored subscriber field value into the mail body and emit it without HTML encoding. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses the online-archive URL for the poisoned subscriber, including administrators who click the plugin-generated link in the Subscribers → History screen.

A vulnerability exists in the PaperCut NG/MF platform's device-scripting functionality due to insufficient sanitization and access restrictions within the embedded execution engine. An authenticated user with administrative access to the management interface can supply a malicious script that escapes the runtime sandbox.  

A successful execution enables an attacker to run unauthorized operating system commands with administrative privileges on the host operating system.

An improper authentication vulnerability in PaperCut MF/NG allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to trigger report generation. By submitting report generation requests without valid credentials, an attacker can generate reports and gain unauthorized access to sensitive information.

An improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory (path traversal) vulnerability in the Scan-to-Fax component of PaperCut NG and PaperCut MF allows an authenticated administrator to execute arbitrary commands on the underlying host via crafted fax provider settings.

Perforce Helix Authentication Service (HAS) deployments that retain the shipped default SCIM bearer token are vulnerable to unauthorized access when the SCIM endpoint is reachable by an attacker. In version 25.2, the installation templates contain a default credential which the installer copies into the active configuration; the installer and configuration script do not automatically replace that value with a random token. An attacker who knows the default token can authenticate to the SCIM API and perform user and group operations allowed by the configured provisioning backend. 





This issue can be chained with CVE-2026-61834 in affected releases of the scim-patch dependency. A crafted SCIM PATCH request can cause server-side prototype pollution, corrupt application state, and disrupt service availability, including health checks and SCIM or SSO requests. In a later test, this primitive was confirmed to enable remote code execution in a Node.js 24/Express deployment through available gadget chains involving child_process, EJS/Pug, or Passport. 





This vulnerability exists in version 2022.1 - 2025.2 of HAS however the underlying defect was removed in version 2026.1 which was released July 17th 2026. The vulnerability was identified in older versions of HAS after version 2026.1 was released.

A vulnerability was found in CRI-O, where it can be requested to take a checkpoint archive of a container and later be asked to restore it. When it does that restoration, it attempts to restore the mounts from the restore archive instead of the pod request. As a result, the validations run on the pod spec, verifying that the pod has access to the mounts it specifies are not applicable to a restored container. This flaw allows a malicious user to trick CRI-O into restoring a pod that doesn't have access to host mounts. The user needs access to the kubelet or cri-o socket to call the restore endpoint and trigger the restore.

A flaw was found in Go. When FIPS mode is enabled on a system, container runtimes may incorrectly handle certain file paths due to improper validation in the containers/common Go library. This flaw allows an attacker to exploit symbolic links and trick the system into mounting sensitive host directories inside a container. This issue also allows attackers to access critical host files, bypassing the intended isolation between containers and the host system.

A vulnerability exists in the bind-propagation option of the Dockerfile RUN --mount instruction. The system does not properly validate the input passed to this option, allowing users to pass arbitrary parameters to the mount instruction. This issue can be exploited to mount sensitive directories from the host into a container during the build process and, in some cases, modify the contents of those mounted files. Even if SELinux is used, this vulnerability can bypass its protection by allowing the source directory to be relabeled to give the container access to host files.

cves.d: In fail2ban 0.10.5 through 1.1.1 before ddd879d, the sshd filter (config/filter.d/sshd.conf) accepts an "on <token>" suffix after the host address. A flaw was found in grub2. During the network boot process, when trying to search for the configuration file, grub copies data from a user controlled environment variable into an internal buffer using the grub_strcpy() function. During this step, it fails to consider the environment variable length when allocating the internal buffer, resulting in an out-of-bounds write. If correctly exploited, this issue may result in remote code execution through the same network segment grub is searching for the boot information, which can be used to by-pass secure boot protections.

OpenS100 through commit daa35b contains an integer overflow vulnerability in the S-102 Bathymetric Surface parser that allows remote attackers to cause a heap-based buffer overflow by opening a crafted S-102 HDF5 file with malicious grid dimension metadata. Attackers can exploit the unvalidated multiplication of numPointsLatitudinal and numPointsLongitudinal values in the S102_VG_BathymetryCoverage::Read() function to trigger a 32-bit integer wraparound, resulting in undersized heap buffer allocation and subsequent out-of-bounds writes that lead to application crash or arbitrary code execution.

plugNmeet Server through 2.5.2 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the whiteboard conversion endpoint that allows any meeting participant to read server files via crafted filePath values. Attackers can supply ../ sequences so text or office documents are converted into page images, then fetch them unauthenticated through /download/uploadedFile/.

ruoyi-ai 3.0.0 through 3.1.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to delete other users' workflows via POST /workflow/del/{uuid}. Attackers can obtain workflow UUIDs from GET /workflow/search and supply them because softDelete() skips the PrivilegeUtil.checkAndGetByUuid() ownership check, removing owners' workflows.

ruoyi-ai 3.0.0 through 3.1.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the GET /workflow/search endpoint that exposes other users' private workflows. Authenticated non-admin users can query this endpoint, which lacks owner or is_public filtering, to list enabled private workflows in the same tenant, including UUIDs and full node and edge configurations.

MOVO through 0.2.3 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the chat-api document endpoints that allows authenticated users to access other users' stored objects by supplying arbitrary object paths. Attackers who know a target's object path can send it to /api/documents/fetch or /api/documents/save-blueprint to read private documents and overwrite presentation blueprints.

A vulnerability was found in k2-fsa sherpa-onnx up to 1.13.8. This issue affects the function OfflineTransducerGreedySearchDecoder::Decode of the file sherpa-onnx/csrc/offline-transducer-greedy-search-decoder.cc of the component Offline Transducer Greedy Search Decoder. The manipulation of the argument vocab_size results in buffer overflow. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. If only official model packs are used and they always keep metadata consistent with the joiner, the bug may not be reachable in normal supported usage. However, from a security and robustness standpoint, the code still contains the vulnerability because it trusts unvalidated model metadata and can be triggered by a malformed or tampered model pack.

A vulnerability has been found in code-projects Online Reviewer System 1.0. This vulnerability affects unknown code of the file /reviewer/system/system/admins/manage/users/btn_functions.php of the component User Profile Update Handler. The manipulation of the argument usertype_id leads to dynamically-determined object attributes. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.

GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 13.11 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2 that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an authenticated user controlling a Kubernetes agent to cause sensitive authentication tokens to be sent to an unintended server due to improper redirect validation in the Kubernetes proxy.

GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 13.6 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2 that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an authenticated user with limited permissions to modify project CI/CD deployment rollback settings without proper authorization, due to insufficient access control checks.

GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 18.11 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2 that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an authenticated user with a project-scoped fine-grained Personal Access Token to permanently delete or modify group-level labels, due to incorrect authorization logic on label ownership scope validation.

GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 17.0 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2 that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an authenticated user with Guest access to read confidential epic content meant to be restricted by external authorization, due to incorrect authorization checks.

GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2 that, under certain conditions, could have allowed a user to poison cached responses for raw repository files, causing targeted users' CI/CD pipelines to execute specially crafted content and potentially exposing protected environment variables, due to improper validation of repository references.

GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 17.4 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2 that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an unauthenticated user to read confidential notes on public projects due to incorrect authorization checks.

GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 18.7 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2 that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an authenticated user with Developer role to execute CI/CD pipelines on protected branches without authorization due to improper authorization checks in the downstream pipeline creation service.

GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 19.1 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2 that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an authenticated user holding a project-scoped fine-grained Personal Access Token to modify integrations belonging to a group outside the token's scope, due to incorrect authorization checks.

GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 18.1 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2 that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an authenticated user to execute arbitrary CI/CD pipelines in a transferred project with the new group's privileges due to improper cleanup of scheduled pipeline execution policy records.

GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 18.9 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2 that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an authenticated user with a fine-grained Personal Access Token scoped only to user-boundary import permissions to import projects into group namespaces beyond the token's intended scope, due to incorrect authorization of the import target namespace.

GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 17.11 before 19.2.8, all 19.3 versions, and 19.4 before 19.4.2 that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an unauthenticated user to read work item contents from private groups and projects due to incorrect authorization checks.

GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 19.2 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2 that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an unauthenticated user to read internal notes and confidential system notes on public projects due to improper authorization in the GraphQL API.

GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 16.11 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2 that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an authenticated user to approve a merge request despite having contributed commits to it, due to improper identity resolution.

GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 19.1 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2  that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an authenticated user to execute arbitrary JavaScript in the context of other users' browser sessions via a specially crafted repository, due to improper sanitization of HTML attributes in syntax-highlighted output.

GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 19.2 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2 that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server via a specially crafted regular expression in a CI/CD configuration, due to insufficient regular expression validation.

GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 19.1 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2 that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an authenticated user to inject specially crafted content into AI agent instructions, potentially causing unintended command execution attributed to other users, due to improper neutralization of special elements in AI conversation context construction.

GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 10.3 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2 that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an authenticated user to perform server-side request forgery and reach internal network resources due to a time-of-check to time-of-use race condition in URL validation during repository import operations.

GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 16.2 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2 that, under certain deployment configurations, could have allowed an authenticated user to poison cached page content served to other users due to improper cache key construction.

GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 12.0 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2 that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an authenticated user with access to GitLab Pages log data to obtain access tokens and other secrets, due to insertion of sensitive request data into log files and error tracking events.

GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 17.6 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2 that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an authenticated user with maintainer-role permissions to remove certain package registry metadata that package protection rules restrict to higher roles, due to improper authorization checks.

A flaw was found in gnutls. An off-by-one error exists in the PKCS#12 bag element bounds check. This vulnerability allows an remote attacker to write past the internal array of a PKCS#12 bag when appending to a bag that already contains 32 elements. This memory corruption could lead to a denial of service (DoS) or potentially other unspecified impacts.

ai.summary_en: A massive influx of 333 vulnerabilities highlights critical remote code execution and authentication bypass risks across the Microsoft ecosystem, severely impacting Windows desktop environments, Azure cloud infrastructure, and enterprise suites including Exchange, SharePoint, and SQL Server. Network infrastructure faces immediate threats from heap overflows and type confusion flaws in DNS, VPN, and routing services, while industrial control systems are targeted by actively exploited authentication bypasses and firmware integrity issues in solutions from Ivanti, Siemens, and multiple IoT manufacturers. Broader security concerns include dangerous unsafe deserialization patterns, buffer overflows, and emerging supply chain risks affecting AI development tools and mobile applications.
ai.summary_zh: 近期爆发的 333 个漏洞凸显了微软生态系统中严重的远程代码执行与身份验证绕过风险，对 Windows 桌面环境、Azure 云基础设施以及 Exchange、SharePoint 和 SQL Server 等企业套件造成严重影响。网络基础设施正面临 DNS、VPN 及路由服务中堆溢出与类型混淆缺陷的直接威胁；工业控制系统则因 Ivanti、Siemens 及多家物联网厂商解决方案中已被利用的身份验证绕过漏洞和固件完整性问题而成为重点攻击目标。此外，广泛存在的安全隐患还包括危险的不安全反序列化模式、缓冲区溢出，以及波及 AI 开发工具与移动应用的新兴供应链风险。

items.reason_en: Critical local privilege escalation in Windows VBS Enclave allows attackers to bypass hardware-enforced security boundaries.
items.reason_zh: Windows VBS Enclave 中的严重本地权限提升漏洞允许攻击者绕过硬件强制的安全边界。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Microsoft Office OneNote enables remote code execution via malicious documents without user interaction.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office OneNote 中的命令注入漏洞可通过恶意文档实现无需用户交互的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the Windows Search Component can be exploited remotely to escalate privileges, impacting endpoint security.
items.reason_zh: Windows Search Component 中的释放后使用漏洞可被远程利用以进行提权，从而影响终端安全。

items.reason_en: Remote Desktop Client vulnerability allows remote code execution via crafted connections, posing a direct threat to administrative workstations.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 漏洞可通过精心构造的连接实现远程代码执行，对管理用工作站构成直接威胁。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Text Shaping enables arbitrary code execution over the network, affecting core rendering subsystems.
items.reason_zh: Windows Text Shaping 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可在网络中实现任意代码执行，影响核心渲染子系统。

items.reason_en: Critical heap-based use-after-free in Microsoft QUIC enables unauthenticated remote code execution over the network.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft QUIC 中的严重基于堆的释放后使用漏洞可实现未经认证的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited command injection in Windows Shell allows attackers to bypass security features remotely, posing an immediate threat to endpoints.
items.reason_zh: Windows Shell 中正在被积极利用的命令注入漏洞允许攻击者远程绕过安全功能，对终端构成即时威胁。

items.reason_en: High-severity untrusted pointer dereference in Windows OLE facilitates remote code execution without requiring user interaction.
items.reason_zh: Windows OLE 中的高危不受信任指针解引用漏洞可导致无需用户交互的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Critical heap-based buffer overflow in Windows BitLocker creates a direct attack path for remote code execution on encrypted systems.
items.reason_zh: Windows BitLocker 中的严重基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞为在加密系统上执行远程代码创建了直接攻击路径。

items.reason_en: A heap-based buffer overflow in the PostScript Printer Driver enables remote code execution without authentication, posing a severe threat to endpoint security and allowing immediate system compromise upon driver loading.
items.reason_zh: PostScript Printer Driver 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现无需认证的远程代码执行，对终端安全构成严重威胁，并在驱动程序加载时即可立即导致系统沦陷。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in the Win32k subsystem allows local privilege escalation, which could grant attackers full administrative control over affected Windows workstations and servers.
items.reason_zh: Win32k subsystem 中的释放后使用漏洞允许本地权限提升，可能使攻击者获得受影响 Windows 工作站和服务器的完全管理控制权。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 remote code execution via heap overflow in MSXML poses severe risk due to widespread document processing across enterprise environments.
items.reason_zh: MSXML 中通过堆溢出实现的 CVSS 9.8 远程代码执行漏洞因在企业环境中广泛涉及文档处理而构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: Critical out-of-bounds write in RPC Runtime allows unauthorized network-based code execution, compromising core Windows inter-process communication.
items.reason_zh: RPC Runtime 中的严重越界写入漏洞允许未经授权的网络代码执行，破坏核心的 Windows 进程间通信机制。

items.reason_en: High-severity heap overflow in Windows Text Shaping enables remote code execution, impacting text rendering engines used by browsers and office suites.
items.reason_zh: Windows Text Shaping 中的高危堆溢出漏洞可实现远程代码执行，影响浏览器和办公套件所使用的文本渲染引擎。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Internet Messaging API allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code, directly threatening email clients and messaging services.
items.reason_zh: Internet Messaging API 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许远程攻击者执行任意代码，直接威胁电子邮件客户端和消息服务。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Windows GDI+ permits remote code execution, exploiting a fundamental graphics subsystem widely used by applications.
items.reason_zh: Windows GDI+ 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，该漏洞利用了应用程序广泛使用的基础图形子系统。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in the SMB Client enables remote privilege escalation over the network, maintaining relevance given SMB's history as a primary lateral movement vector.
items.reason_zh: SMB Client 中的堆溢出漏洞可实现网络远程权限提升，鉴于 SMB 历来是主要的横向移动途径，该漏洞仍具重要威胁。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in the DNS Server service allows remote code execution, posing a direct threat to critical network name resolution infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server service 中的不受信任指针解引用漏洞可导致远程代码执行，对关键的网络名称解析基础设施构成直接威胁。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows Search Component allows remote code execution, affecting indexers and search functionality across endpoints.
items.reason_zh: Windows Search Component 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，影响各终端上的索引器和搜索功能。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in Windows Event Tracing enables remote code execution, potentially allowing attackers to bypass logging mechanisms and maintain persistence.
items.reason_zh: Windows Event Tracing 中的堆溢出漏洞可实现远程代码执行，可能使攻击者绕过日志记录机制并维持持久化访问。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in the Partition Management Driver allows remote code execution, targeting storage drivers that handle disk operations system-wide.
items.reason_zh: Partition Management Driver 中的越界读取漏洞可导致远程代码执行，其目标为处理全系统磁盘操作的存储驱动程序。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Hyper-V allows local privilege escalation within virtual machines, risking host isolation and cloud workloads.
items.reason_zh: Hyper-V 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许在虚拟机内进行本地权限提升，危及主机隔离性和云工作负载安全。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the Camera Frame Server Monitor enables adjacent network privilege escalation, expanding the attack surface for peripheral-connected devices.
items.reason_zh: Camera Frame Server Monitor 中的释放后使用漏洞可实现相邻网络权限提升，扩大了外设连接设备的攻击面。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows NTLM affects legacy authentication protocols, increasing risks for environments relying on NTLMv1 or misconfigured security policies.
items.reason_zh: Windows NTLM 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞影响遗留身份验证协议，增加了依赖 NTLMv1 或安全策略配置不当环境的运行风险。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Windows Kerberos impacts directory authentication services, potentially allowing local attackers to escalate privileges within Active Directory domains.
items.reason_zh: Windows Kerberos 中的释放后使用漏洞影响目录身份验证服务，可能使本地攻击者在 Active Directory 域内实现权限提升。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Win32K targets the core kernel-mode graphics subsystem, a historically frequent attack vector for local privilege escalation exploits.
items.reason_zh: Win32K 中的释放后使用漏洞针对核心内核模式图形子系统，该子系统历来是本地权限提升漏洞利用的高频攻击向量。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 heap buffer overflow in Windows Error Reporting enables remote code execution without authentication, severely compromising endpoint security.
items.reason_zh: Windows Error Reporting 中 CVSS 9.8 的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现无需认证的远程代码执行，严重损害终端安全。

items.reason_en: Critical CVSS 9.8 flaw in Windows Media Foundation allows attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely by processing malicious media payloads.
items.reason_zh: Windows Media Foundation 中的严重 CVSS 9.8 漏洞允许攻击者通过处理恶意媒体载荷来远程执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: High-severity CVSS 9.8 heap overflow in the System Information Console facilitates unrestricted remote code execution over the network.
items.reason_zh: System Information Console 中高危 CVSS 9.8 的堆溢出漏洞可导致网络无限制远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Windows Error Reporting (CVSS 8.8) allows remote attackers to bypass security controls and achieve system-level access.
items.reason_zh: Windows Error Reporting (CVSS 8.8) 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许远程攻击者绕过安全控制并获取系统级访问权限。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Libarchive (CVSS 8.8) poses a significant risk for remote code execution when handling compressed archives.
items.reason_zh: Windows Libarchive（CVSS 8.8）中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出在处理压缩归档文件时存在导致远程代码执行的重大风险。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the Windows Storport Miniport Driver (CVSS 8.8) enables remote code execution, threatening storage subsystem integrity.
items.reason_zh: Windows Storport Miniport Driver（CVSS 8.8）中的释放后使用漏洞可导致远程代码执行，威胁存储子系统完整性。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in LSASS allows remote code execution over the network. This targets a critical Windows security component, potentially granting attackers full domain control.
items.reason_zh: LSASS 中的越界写入漏洞允许通过网络进行远程代码执行。该漏洞针对关键的 Windows 安全组件，可能导致攻击者获得完整的域控制权。

items.reason_en: Double free in Outlook enables remote code execution over the network. As a widely deployed email client, this flaw is highly attractive for targeted phishing campaigns.
items.reason_zh: Outlook 中的双重释放漏洞允许通过网络进行远程代码执行。作为一款广泛部署的电子邮件客户端，此缺陷对定向网络钓鱼活动极具吸引力。

items.reason_en: Use after free in PowerPoint permits remote code execution. Document-based exploits remain a primary delivery method for ransomware and espionage groups.
items.reason_zh: PowerPoint 中的释放后使用漏洞可允许远程代码执行。基于文档的攻击利用仍是勒索软件和间谍组织的主要传播途径。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the PostScript Printer Driver allows remote code execution. The driver's ubiquitous presence across enterprise environments increases exploitation likelihood.
items.reason_zh: PostScript Printer Driver 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可允许远程代码执行。该驱动程序在企业环境中广泛存在，增加了被利用的可能性。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in Windows Raw Image Extension leads to remote code execution. Processing untrusted images can trigger memory corruption without direct user interaction.
items.reason_zh: Windows Raw Image Extension 中的整数溢出漏洞会导致远程代码执行。处理不受信任的图像可能在无需用户直接交互的情况下触发内存损坏。

items.reason_en: Double free in the Failover Cluster Virtual Driver enables remote code execution. This impacts high-availability infrastructure and requires immediate patching to prevent cluster compromise.
items.reason_zh: Failover Cluster Virtual Driver 中的双重释放漏洞可启用远程代码执行。该漏洞影响高可用基础设施，需立即打补丁以防止集群被攻破。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Client-Side Caching service allows remote privilege escalation. Network-accessible memory corruption can compromise local administrative boundaries.
items.reason_zh: Client-Side Caching 服务中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可允许远程权限提升。可通过网络访问的内存损坏会破坏本地管理边界。

items.reason_en: Use after free in the Windows Kernel permits local privilege escalation. Kernel-level flaws undermine system integrity and enable persistent rootkit deployment.
items.reason_zh: Windows Kernel 中的释放后使用漏洞可允许本地权限提升。内核级缺陷会破坏系统完整性，并支持持久化 Rootkit 部署。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Volume Manager Extension Driver enables unauthenticated network code execution with a critical CVSS score of 9.8.
items.reason_zh: Volume Manager Extension Driver 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可允许未经身份验证的网络代码执行，其严重性 CVSS 评分高达 9.8。

items.reason_en: A double-free vulnerability in the Windows Shell allows unauthorized network attackers to execute arbitrary code, posing a significant risk to endpoint stability.
items.reason_zh: Windows Shell 中的双重释放漏洞允许未经授权的网络攻击者执行任意代码，对终端稳定性构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: A double-free flaw in the Hyper-V hypervisor permits local privilege escalation, potentially breaking VM isolation and compromising host resources.
items.reason_zh: Hyper-V hypervisor 中的双重释放缺陷可允许本地权限提升，可能破坏虚拟机隔离性并危及主机资源。

items.reason_en: An integer overflow in the VBS Enclave component allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges locally, undermining hardware-enforced security boundaries.
items.reason_zh: VBS Enclave 组件中的整数溢出漏洞允许已授权攻击者在本地提升权限，破坏硬件强制的安全边界。

items.reason_en: An integer overflow in PowerShell enables local code execution, which can be leveraged by malware to bypass script execution policies and compromise endpoints.
items.reason_zh: PowerShell 中的整数溢出漏洞可启用本地代码执行，恶意软件可利用此漏洞绕过脚本执行策略并感染终端。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Media Foundation enables remote code execution over the network, making it a high-value target for file-based attacks.
items.reason_zh: Windows Media Foundation 中 CVSS 评分为 9.8 的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可允许通过网络进行远程代码执行，使其成为基于文件的攻击的高价值目标。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 remote code execution in RRAS allows attackers to fully compromise network routing infrastructure without authentication.
items.reason_zh: RRAS 中 CVSS 评分为 9.8 的远程代码执行漏洞允许攻击者在无需身份验证的情况下完全控制网络路由基础设施。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 out-of-bounds write in LSASS directly threatens credential storage, enabling immediate privilege escalation and lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: LSASS 中 CVSS 评分为 8.8 的越界写入漏洞直接威胁凭据存储，可实现即时权限提升和横向移动。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows Imaging Component is frequently weaponized via malicious images embedded in documents or emails.
items.reason_zh: Windows Imaging Component 中 CVSS 评分为 9.8 的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞常被武器化，通过嵌入文档或邮件中的恶意图像进行利用。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 out-of-bounds read in Microsoft Office Excel allows remote code execution through crafted spreadsheet files, targeting a massive user base.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Excel 中 CVSS 评分为 8.8 的越界读取漏洞允许通过构造的电子表格文件实现远程代码执行，目标用户群体庞大。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 heap-based buffer overflow in PPP EAP-TLS compromises VPN authentication protocols, enabling remote code execution over adjacent networks.
items.reason_zh: PPP EAP-TLS 中 CVSS 评分为 9.8 的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞会破坏 VPN 认证协议，允许在相邻网络中进行远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 integer underflow in Network Policy Server allows unauthenticated remote code execution, breaking network access control enforcement.
items.reason_zh: Network Policy Server 中 CVSS 评分为 9.8 的整数下溢漏洞允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行，破坏网络访问控制策略的执行。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office Access enables remote code execution via malicious database files distributed through phishing.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Access 中 CVSS 评分为 8.8 的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过钓鱼分发的恶意数据库文件实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.1 use-after-free in MSXML remains highly exploitable due to its deep integration across legacy and modern Windows applications.
items.reason_zh: MSXML 中 CVSS 评分为 8.1 的释放后使用漏洞因其深度集成于传统与现代 Windows 应用程序中，仍具有极高的可利用性。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 reliance on untrusted inputs in PowerShell allows unauthenticated remote code execution, facilitating rapid post-exploitation automation.
items.reason_zh: PowerShell 中 CVSS 评分为 8.8 的对不可信输入的依赖允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行，便于快速实现漏洞利用后的自动化操作。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 integer underflow in DNS Server enables unauthenticated remote code execution, posing a critical threat to foundational network infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 中 CVSS 评分为 9.8 的整数下溢漏洞可启用未经身份验证的远程代码执行，对基础网络基础设施构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 use-after-free in Network Load Balancing allows unauthenticated remote code execution, severely impacting enterprise service availability.
items.reason_zh: Network Load Balancing 中 CVSS 评分为 9.8 的释放后使用漏洞允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行，严重影响企业服务的可用性。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Shell permits unauthenticated network code execution, leveraging widespread user interaction and file handling vectors.
items.reason_zh: Windows Shell 中 CVSS 评分为 9.8 的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可允许未经身份验证的网络代码执行，利用广泛的用户交互和文件处理途径。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 use-after-free in CCFFilter Driver enables unauthenticated remote code execution, compromising kernel-mode stability and system integrity.
items.reason_zh: CCFFilter Driver 中 CVSS 评分为 9.8 的释放后使用漏洞可启用未经身份验证的远程代码执行，破坏内核模式稳定性和系统完整性。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 heap-based buffer overflow in Error Reporting allows unauthenticated remote code execution, exploiting automatically triggered diagnostic routines.
items.reason_zh: Error Reporting 中 CVSS 评分为 9.8 的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行，利用自动触发的诊断例程。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 integer underflow in PowerShell enables unauthenticated remote code execution, threatening critical administrative and automation workflows.
items.reason_zh: PowerShell 中的 CVSS 9.8 整数下溢漏洞可导致未授权远程代码执行，严重威胁关键的管理与自动化工作流。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 untrusted pointer dereference in CD-ROM Driver allows unauthenticated network code execution, exploitable via mounted virtual drives or network shares.
items.reason_zh: CD-ROM Driver 中的 CVSS 8.8 不可信指针解引用漏洞允许未授权的网络代码执行，可通过挂载的虚拟驱动器或网络共享进行利用。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 heap-based buffer overflow in GDI enables unauthenticated network code execution, targeting core graphics rendering subsystems used across applications.
items.reason_zh: GDI 中的 CVSS 8.8 基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致未授权的网络代码执行，影响跨应用程序使用的核心图形渲染子系统。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 heap-based buffer overflow in Remote Desktop Client permits unauthenticated network code execution, directly endangering remote administration sessions.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 中的 CVSS 8.8 基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未授权的网络代码执行，直接危及远程管理会话。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 type confusion in DNS Server allows unauthenticated network code execution, undermining fundamental name resolution and caching services.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 中的 CVSS 8.8 类型混淆漏洞允许未授权的网络代码执行，破坏基础名称解析与缓存服务。

items.reason_en: Critical heap overflow in Rich Text Edit Control enables unauthorized remote code execution over a network, posing severe risks via malicious documents.
items.reason_zh: Rich Text Edit Control 存在关键堆溢出漏洞，可导致通过网络执行的未授权远程代码执行，通过恶意文档带来严重安全风险。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in LSASS allows local privilege escalation, directly threatening credential security and enabling lateral movement across endpoints.
items.reason_zh: LSASS 中的释放后使用漏洞可导致本地权限提升，直接威胁凭据安全并支持在终端节点间横向移动。

items.reason_en: Kernel-level heap overflow compromises core OS stability and allows local privilege escalation, requiring immediate patching to prevent system compromise.
items.reason_zh: 内核级堆溢出会破坏核心操作系统稳定性并允许本地权限提升，需立即修补以防止系统被攻陷。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in the Overlay Filter driver can lead to local code execution, impacting graphics and display subsystems used by desktop environments.
items.reason_zh: Overlay Filter 驱动中的越界读取漏洞可能导致本地代码执行，影响桌面环境所使用的图形与显示子系统。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Libarchive enables remote code execution over the network. This flaw poses a critical risk as crafted archive files are commonly distributed via email and web downloads.
items.reason_zh: Windows Libarchive 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致通过网络执行的远程代码执行。该漏洞构成关键风险，因为构造的归档文件常通过电子邮件和网页下载进行分发。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Microsoft PostScript Printer Driver allows remote code execution over the network. Printer drivers are universally installed, making this a high-value lateral movement vector.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft PostScript Printer Driver 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过网络执行的远程代码执行。打印机驱动程序普遍安装，使其成为高价值的横向移动攻击向量。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office Access permits remote code execution over the network. Attackers frequently exploit Office-related flaws through phishing campaigns targeting end users.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Access 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过网络执行的远程代码执行。攻击者经常针对最终用户的钓鱼活动来利用与 Office 相关的漏洞。

items.reason_en: Origin validation error in Legacy Update ActiveX control allows remote code execution. The extremely high CVSS score reflects its potential to compromise outdated systems during maintenance operations.
items.reason_zh: Legacy Update ActiveX 控件中的源验证错误可导致远程代码执行。极高的 CVSS 评分反映了其在维护操作期间攻陷过时系统的潜在能力。

items.reason_en: Substance3D Stager contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability that can lead to arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, posing a direct threat to creative professionals handling untrusted assets.
items.reason_zh: Substance3D Stager 存在越界读取漏洞，可在当前用户上下文中导致任意代码执行，对处理不可信素材的创意专业人士构成直接威胁。

items.reason_en: Photoshop Desktop suffers from an incorrect authorization flaw that bypasses security checks and enables remote code execution, compromising workstation integrity upon opening malicious files.
items.reason_zh: Photoshop Desktop 存在授权校验缺陷，可绕过安全检查并实现远程代码执行，在打开恶意文件时将危及工作站完整性。

items.reason_en: Adobe Dimension's untrusted search path vulnerability allows local attackers with user permissions to execute arbitrary code by manipulating library loading sequences.
items.reason_zh: Adobe Dimension 的不可信搜索路径漏洞允许具有用户权限的本地攻击者通过操纵库加载顺序来执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Local privilege escalation flaw in Adobe Dimension allows arbitrary code execution within the user context, posing a direct threat to creative professionals.
items.reason_zh: Adobe Dimension 的本地权限提升漏洞允许在用户上下文中执行任意代码，对创意专业人士构成直接威胁。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Red Hat's Mutter Wayland compositor enables local attackers to achieve arbitrary code execution by exploiting asynchronous ICC file reads.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat 的 Mutter Wayland 合成器中存在释放后使用漏洞，本地攻击者可利用异步 ICC 文件读取实现任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Improper process termination on macOS leaves VeraCrypt decrypted volumes accessible after reported dismount, risking sensitive data exposure.
items.reason_zh: macOS 上的进程终止不当会导致 VeraCrypt 解密卷在报告卸载后仍可访问，存在敏感数据泄露风险。

items.reason_en: Untrusted document paths and PDF link targets are interpolated into notification text that ParseTip() interprets as trusted markup. Clicking an injected link triggers ExecuteTipLink(), enabling arbitrary command execution on the host system.
items.reason_zh: 不可信的文档路径和 PDF 链接目标会被插入到通知文本中，ParseTip() 将其解释为可信标记。点击注入的链接将触发 ExecuteTipLink()，从而在主机系统上实现任意命令执行。

items.reason_en: A navigation allowlist bypass via string-prefix URL matching lets attackers load arbitrary origins in the main window. This can lead to credential theft, session hijacking, or phishing within the desktop application context.
items.reason_zh: 通过字符串前缀 URL 匹配绕过导航白名单，使攻击者能够在主窗口中加载任意来源。这可能导致桌面应用上下文中的凭据窃取、会话劫持或网络钓鱼。

items.reason_en: OS command injection occurs through unsanitized output folder paths in the UVR5 WebUI. Unauthenticated attackers can inject shell metacharacters to execute arbitrary system commands directly on the host machine.
items.reason_zh: UVR5 WebUI 中未经清理的输出文件夹路径会导致操作系统命令注入。未授权的攻击者可注入 Shell 元字符，直接在主机上执行任意系统命令。

items.reason_en: Buffer overflow in Zoom Phone clients allows unauthenticated privilege escalation via network access, impacting widespread desktop deployments.
items.reason_zh: Zoom Phone 客户端中的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过网络访问进行未授权权限提升，影响广泛的桌面部署。

items.reason_en: Improper data sanitization in IBM i HTTP Server Administration enables remote code execution and sensitive information disclosure.
items.reason_zh: IBM i HTTP Server Administration 中的数据清理不当可导致远程代码执行和敏感信息泄露。

items.reason_en: Local buffer overflow in AMI APTIOV BIOS can lead to arbitrary code execution and complete system compromise.
items.reason_zh: AMI APTIOV BIOS 中的本地缓冲区溢出可导致任意代码执行和系统完全沦陷。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in FreeRDP smartcard handling allows reuse of freed handles, potentially enabling code execution.
items.reason_zh: FreeRDP 智能卡处理中的释放后使用漏洞允许重用已释放句柄，可能实现代码执行。

items.reason_en: Unbounded busy loop in Red Hat gnome-remote-desktop VNC TLS handlers causes remote denial of service.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat gnome-remote-desktop VNC TLS 处理器中的无界忙循环会导致远程拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Presence of a vendor test key in UEFI Secure Boot databases allows loading of unsigned kernels and modules.
items.reason_zh: UEFI Secure Boot 数据库中存在厂商测试密钥，允许加载未签名的内核和模块。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 unauthenticated RCE in AnyDesk allows remote code execution as root on Linux without victim approval, posing an extreme threat to remote support workflows.
items.reason_zh: AnyDesk 中的 CVSS 9.8 未授权远程代码执行漏洞可在无需受害者批准的情况下以 root 身份在 Linux 上执行远程代码，对远程支持工作流构成极端威胁。

items.reason_en: Missing Hardened Runtime signing on macOS DigiD enables local dylib injection via DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES, bypassing Apple's code integrity protections.
items.reason_zh: macOS DigiD 缺少 Hardened Runtime 签名，可通过 DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES 实现本地 dylib 注入，绕过 Apple 的代码完整性保护。

items.reason_en: Integer underflow in OpenVPN for Android allows authenticated remote servers to trigger denial of service or sensitive memory disclosure on mobile devices.
items.reason_zh: OpenVPN for Android 中的整数下溢漏洞允许已认证的远程服务器在移动设备上触发拒绝服务或导致敏感内存泄露。

items.reason_en: Incorrect permission assignment in Windows Mobile Broadband allows local privilege escalation. This directly impacts cellular connectivity modules found in laptops and mobile hotspots.
items.reason_zh: Windows Mobile Broadband 中的权限分配错误可导致本地权限提升。该漏洞直接影响笔记本电脑和移动热点中搭载的蜂窝网络连接模块。

items.reason_en: Omnispace Agora Project's mobile file download route suffers from broken access control, allowing unauthenticated attackers to retrieve arbitrary files by guessing MD5 tokens instead of performing proper authorization.
items.reason_zh: Omnispace Agora Project 的移动文件下载路由存在访问控制失效问题，攻击者无需认证即可通过猜测 MD5 令牌获取任意文件，而非执行正确的授权流程。

items.reason_en: A predictable password-reset token mechanism based on SHA1 hashing enables unauthenticated attackers to deterministically derive reset codes and take over user accounts.
items.reason_zh: 基于 SHA1 哈希的可预测密码重置令牌机制使未认证攻击者能够确定性推导出重置码并接管用户账户。

items.reason_en: Missing function-level authorization checks allow non-administrative members to create new user accounts, violating least-privilege principles in the mobile application ecosystem.
items.reason_zh: 缺失函数级授权检查使得非管理员成员能够创建新用户账户，违反了移动应用生态中的最小权限原则。

items.reason_en: Bluetooth Low Energy protocol flaw forces unwanted channel disconnections, disrupting connectivity and stability in mobile and wearable ecosystems.
items.reason_zh: 蓝牙低功耗（BLE）协议缺陷会导致非预期的信道断开，破坏移动与可穿戴设备生态的连接性与稳定性。

items.reason_en: The Dio HTTP client follows redirects without comparing source and destination origins, copying headers blindly. This enables cross-origin data leakage or malicious redirect attacks in Flutter-based mobile applications.
