items.reason_zh: Dio HTTP 客户端在未比对源与目标来源的情况下盲目跟随重定向并复制请求头。此缺陷可导致基于 Flutter 的移动应用发生跨域数据泄露或遭受恶意重定向攻击。

items.reason_en: Flawed custom URL scheme handler in Zoom Workplace for Android permits unauthenticated privilege escalation through network-based attacks.
items.reason_zh: Zoom Workplace for Android 中存在缺陷的自定义 URL 方案处理器，可通过基于网络的攻击实现未认证的权限提升。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.9 use-after-free in Samsung's WSM service allows local attackers to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code with system-level access.
items.reason_zh: 三星 WSM 服务中存在 CVSS 8.9 的释放后使用（UAF）漏洞，允许本地攻击者提升权限并以系统级访问执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Improper input validation in the Samsung HEIF decoder enables local code execution when processing maliciously crafted image files.
items.reason_zh: 三星 HEIF 解码器的输入验证不当漏洞在处理恶意构造的图像文件时可导致本地代码执行。

items.reason_en: Zephyr RTOS exhibits a race condition in system call entry on Cortex-M architectures, enabling malicious userspace processes to escalate privileges and compromise isolated IoT workloads.
items.reason_zh: Zephyr RTOS 在 Cortex-M 架构的系统调用入口处存在竞态条件，使恶意用户态进程能够提升权限并破坏隔离的 IoT 工作负载。

items.reason_en: iflytek Astron Agent defaults to LocalExecutor for workflow code nodes without explicit configuration, allowing attackers to achieve remote code execution within agentic IoT orchestration pipelines.
items.reason_zh: iflytek Astron Agent 在未显式配置的情况下默认对工作流代码节点使用 LocalExecutor，使攻击者能够在智能体 IoT 编排管道中实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: OpenRemote processes uploaded ETS project ZIPs with an unsafe Saxon TransformerFactoryImpl, enabling XML injection attacks that can compromise connected building automation and IoT gateways.
items.reason_zh: OpenRemote 使用不安全的 Saxon TransformerFactoryImpl 处理上传的 ETS 项目 ZIP 包，从而引发 XML 注入攻击，可能导致连接的楼宇自动化系统与 IoT 网关沦陷。

items.reason_en: Unvalidated parameters in Zephyr RTOS can trigger unexpected internal operations, potentially destabilizing resource-constrained embedded devices.
items.reason_zh: Zephyr RTOS 中的未验证参数可能触发意外的内部操作，进而导致资源受限的嵌入式设备运行不稳定。

items.reason_en: Remote stack-based buffer overflow in Linksys router firmware allows arbitrary code execution and is already publicly exploited.
items.reason_zh: Linksys 路由器固件中存在远程栈缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致任意代码执行，且目前已被公开利用。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass in user role retrieval methods fails to verify that the target UUID belongs to the requesting user. Attackers can escalate privileges and access admin-level IoT platform configurations without proper ownership checks.
items.reason_zh: 用户角色检索方法中的授权绕过漏洞未验证目标 UUID 是否属于请求用户。攻击者可在缺乏适当所有权检查的情况下提升权限并访问管理级 IoT 平台配置。

items.reason_en: The CoAP fileserver ignores initialization failure returns from _resp_init(), leading to undefined state handling. This flaw can trigger crashes or denial of service in embedded IoT devices relying on RIOT OS networking stacks.
items.reason_zh: CoAP 文件服务器忽略了 _resp_init() 返回的初始化失败结果，导致未定义的状态处理。此缺陷可能引发依赖 RIOT OS 网络协议栈的嵌入式 IoT 设备崩溃或拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Insecure direct object reference in DeviceController allows low-privilege users to enumerate sequential device IDs. Attackers can read and modify other tenants' IoT device configurations, breaking multi-tenant isolation.
items.reason_zh: DeviceController 中存在不安全的直接对象引用（IDOR）漏洞，使低权限用户能够枚举连续的设备 ID。攻击者可读取并修改其他租户的 IoT 设备配置，破坏多租户隔离机制。

items.reason_en: Critical remote command injection in Edimax router firmware allows full device takeover, with publicly disclosed exploits increasing real-world risk.
items.reason_zh: Edimax 路由器固件中存在关键远程命令注入漏洞，可导致设备被完全接管，且公开披露的利用工具进一步增加了现实风险。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated webserver password change on Rockwell ArmorBlock I/O devices enables immediate admin takeover.
items.reason_zh: Rockwell ArmorBlock I/O 设备的 Web 服务器支持未认证密码更改，可导致管理员权限被立即接管。

items.reason_en: Default SNMPv3 USM key in Huawei openUBMC allows unauthenticated access and traffic decryption.
items.reason_zh: Huawei openUBMC 使用默认的 SNMPv3 USM 密钥，导致未认证访问及流量解密风险。

items.reason_en: Critical vulnerability in Siemens APOGEE building automation controllers impacts operational integrity.
items.reason_zh: Siemens APOGEE 楼宇自动化控制器中的关键漏洞严重影响其操作完整性。

items.reason_en: Similar high-severity flaw in Siemens APOGEE series threatens industrial IoT device stability and control.
items.reason_zh: Siemens APOGEE 系列中的类似高危漏洞对工业 IoT 设备的稳定性与控制构成威胁。

items.reason_en: CVSS 10 remote OS command injection in the Wavlink wmapd daemon has publicly available exploits, allowing immediate full device compromise.
items.reason_zh: Wavlink wmapd 守护进程中存在 CVSS 10 的远程操作系统命令注入漏洞，已有公开利用工具，可导致设备立即被完全控制。

items.reason_en: Cryptographic signature verification bypass in D-Link's emergency HTTP recovery server permits unauthorized firmware flashing and persistent malware installation.
items.reason_zh: D-Link 紧急 HTTP 恢复服务器存在加密签名验证绕过漏洞，允许未授权的固件刷写及持久化恶意软件安装。

items.reason_en: CVSS 10.0 vulnerability in Microsoft Partner Center allows unauthorized privilege elevation through flawed certificate validation.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Partner Center 中存在 CVSS 10.0 的漏洞，因证书验证逻辑缺陷可导致未授权的权限提升。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in Azure App Service permits remote code execution, directly compromising cloud-hosted applications.
items.reason_zh: Azure App Service 中缺失身份验证机制，可导致远程代码执行，直接危及云托管应用。

items.reason_en: Unsafe deserialization in Microsoft Dataverse allows attackers to execute arbitrary code over the network.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Dataverse 中存在不安全的反序列化漏洞，使攻击者能够通过网络执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Weak authentication mechanisms in Active Directory Federation Services enable network-based spoofing attacks against enterprise identity flows.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Federation Services 中的弱身份验证机制易受基于网络的欺骗攻击，威胁企业身份流转安全。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in the Azure SRE Agent allows privilege escalation over the network, risking control plane compromise.
items.reason_zh: Azure SRE Agent 中缺失授权检查，允许通过网络提升权限，存在控制平面被攻破的风险。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Dynamics Business Central enables unauthenticated remote code execution in cloud-hosted environments.
items.reason_zh: Dynamics Business Central 中不受信任数据的反序列化漏洞可导致在云托管环境中发生未认证的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Injection flaw in Azure Storage Library allows authenticated attackers to escalate privileges across cloud storage services.
items.reason_zh: Azure Storage Library 中的注入缺陷允许已认证攻击者在云存储服务间提升权限。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in Azure CycleCloud permits local code execution by authorized users, risking container orchestration stability.
items.reason_zh: Azure CycleCloud 中的操作系统命令注入漏洞允许授权用户执行本地代码，危及容器编排的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Improper restriction of communication channels in Azure Key Vault allows privilege escalation over the network, risking compromise of sensitive cryptographic keys, secrets, and cloud identity management workflows.
items.reason_zh: Azure Key Vault 中通信通道限制不当允许通过网络提升权限，可能导致敏感加密密钥、机密及云身份管理工作流遭破坏。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in Azure Attestation service (CVSS 7.5) risks exposing sensitive device health and identity metadata, undermining cloud trust frameworks.
items.reason_zh: Azure Attestation 服务（CVSS 7.5）中的越界读取漏洞可能暴露敏感的设备健康与身份元数据，破坏云信任框架。

items.reason_en: Similar information disclosure flaw in Azure Attestation (CVSS 7.5) could allow attackers to fingerprint cloud infrastructure or bypass conditional access policies.
items.reason_zh: Azure Attestation 中类似的信息泄露漏洞（CVSS 7.5）可能使攻击者能够识别云基础设施指纹或绕过条件访问策略。

items.reason_en: A use-after-free flaw in Windows Failover Cluster allows unauthenticated network code execution, critically impacting high-availability enterprise workloads.
items.reason_zh: Windows Failover Cluster 中的释放后使用漏洞允许未认证的远程网络代码执行，严重影响高可用性企业工作负载。

items.reason_en: An origin validation error in Microsoft Power Apps enables network-based code execution, exposing low-code application platforms to cross-site and injection attacks.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Power Apps 中的源验证错误可导致基于网络的代码执行，使低代码应用平台面临跨站脚本和注入攻击风险。

items.reason_en: Information disclosure in Azure HDInsight allows unauthorized actors to retrieve sensitive cluster data over the network, violating cloud tenant isolation.
items.reason_zh: Azure HDInsight 中的信息泄露漏洞允许未授权实体通过网络检索敏感集群数据，违反云租户隔离原则。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.5 memory allocation flaw in AD FS can trigger denial of service, disrupting enterprise identity federation and single sign-on capabilities.
items.reason_zh: AD FS 中 CVSS 7.5 的内存分配缺陷可触发拒绝服务攻击，中断企业身份联合与单点登录功能。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.5 lack of resource throttling in AD FS enables attackers to exhaust server resources, impacting cloud authentication availability.
items.reason_zh: AD FS 中 CVSS 7.5 的资源限流缺失漏洞可使攻击者耗尽服务器资源，影响云认证服务的可用性。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.5 improper authentication in Dynamics Business Central allows unauthorized network actors to disclose sensitive ERP and financial data.
items.reason_zh: Dynamics Business Central 中 CVSS 7.5 的身份验证不当漏洞允许未授权网络实体泄露敏感的 ERP 和财务数据。

items.reason_en: Improper access control in Windows Hyper-V allows local code execution within the hypervisor environment. This threatens tenant isolation and could lead to full host compromise in cloud deployments.
items.reason_zh: Windows Hyper-V 中的访问控制不当漏洞允许在虚拟机监控程序环境中执行本地代码。这威胁到租户隔离，并可能在云部署中导致主机完全沦陷。

items.reason_en: Local privilege escalation in the Ansible POSIX authorized_key module via a symlink race condition. Misconfigured automation pipelines relying on this module are at risk of unauthorized key injection.
items.reason_zh: Ansible POSIX authorized_key 模块通过符号链接竞态条件实现本地提权。依赖该模块的错误配置自动化流水线将面临未授权密钥注入风险。

items.reason_en: Podman silently ignores critical container restrictions like --cap-drop=ALL when processing images with specific checkpoint annotations, effectively bypassing security policies and enabling container escapes.
items.reason_zh: Podman 在处理带有特定检查点注解的镜像时，会静默忽略 --cap-drop=ALL 等关键容器限制，从而有效绕过安全策略并导致容器逃逸。

items.reason_en: Cocos AI's AMD SEV-SNP verifier fails to enforce ReportData validation when nil or empty values are supplied, weakening the cryptographic guarantees required for confidential cloud computing environments.
items.reason_zh: Cocos AI 的 AMD SEV-SNP 验证器在传入空值或零值时未能强制执行 ReportData 验证，削弱了机密云计算环境所需的密码学保障。

items.reason_en: Xorbits Xoscar contains an unauthenticated deserialization flaw over its actor-pool TCP channel, allowing remote attackers to execute arbitrary code within distributed AI compute clusters.
items.reason_zh: Xorbits Xoscar 在其 actor-pool TCP 通道中存在未认证的反序列化漏洞，允许远程攻击者在分布式 AI 计算集群中执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Hard-coded admin credentials and JWT secrets in Docker deployments allow immediate containerized application takeover by unauthenticated attackers.
items.reason_zh: Docker 部署中硬编码的管理员凭据和 JWT 密钥可使未认证攻击者立即接管容器化应用程序。

items.reason_en: Global authentication bypass via static asset extension matching grants unauthenticated remote attackers full administrative mutation capabilities.
items.reason_zh: 通过静态资源扩展名匹配实现的全局认证绕过，赋予未认证远程攻击者完整的管理员修改能力。

items.reason_en: Annotation-based SSRF in Kubeflow enables namespace users to exfiltrate controller service account tokens, risking Kubernetes cluster compromise.
items.reason_zh: Kubeflow 中基于注解的 SSRF 漏洞使命名空间用户能够窃取控制器服务账户令牌，危及 Kubernetes 集群安全。

items.reason_en: PostDelete resource hooks in Argo CD bypass AppProject destination and resource authorization checks. Malicious actors can exploit this to deploy unauthorized workloads or modify cluster states, risking full GitOps pipeline compromise.
items.reason_zh: Argo CD 中的 PostDelete 资源钩子绕过了 AppProject 目标和资源授权检查。恶意攻击者可利用此漏洞部署未授权的工作负载或修改集群状态，导致整个 GitOps 流水线被攻破。

items.reason_en: Incorrect privilege assignment during Docker Hub account-to-organization conversion allows token reassignment between users without secret rotation. This grants persistent unauthorized access to organization resources even after password changes.
items.reason_zh: Docker Hub 账号转换为组织过程中权限分配错误，允许在不轮换密钥的情况下进行用户间令牌重分配。即使更改密码，仍会授予对组织资源的持续未授权访问权限。

items.reason_en: Container escape occurs because nsenter attaches to host namespaces without the --root flag. Agent-run code in isolated workspaces can resolve absolute host paths, reading or modifying critical host filesystem files.
items.reason_zh: 由于 nsenter 在未使用 --root 标志的情况下附加到宿主机命名空间，导致容器逃逸。隔离工作区中运行的代理代码可解析绝对宿主机路径，读取或修改关键的宿主机文件系统文件。

items.reason_en: An exposed dangerous endpoint in Ivanti Neurons Patch for Intune leaks sensitive authentication information to remote authenticated attackers. This severely undermines cloud patch management infrastructure and identity federation security.
items.reason_zh: Ivanti Neurons Patch for Intune 中暴露的危险端点向远程已认证攻击者泄露敏感认证信息。这严重破坏了云补丁管理基础设施和身份联合安全性。

items.reason_en: Incorrect file permissions on containerd configuration files allow local unprivileged users to modify runtime settings and escalate privileges.
items.reason_zh: containerd 配置文件权限设置不当，允许本地非特权用户修改运行时设置并提升权限。

items.reason_en: Unsanitized container image reference in IBM Maximo Kubernetes operator template risks container escape or malicious pulls.
items.reason_zh: IBM Maximo Kubernetes operator 模板中未过滤的容器镜像引用存在容器逃逸或恶意拉取的风险。

items.reason_en: Shell command injection via unsanitized values in IBM Maximo K8s operator tasks enables remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: IBM Maximo K8s operator 任务中通过未过滤的值注入 Shell 命令，可导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Unrestricted Velocity mapping templates in Floci allow unauthenticated attackers to execute system commands.
items.reason_zh: Floci 中未受限制的 Velocity 映射模板允许未认证攻击者执行系统命令。

items.reason_en: Privasys Enclave OS TDX/GPU attestation omits active session binding, breaking confidential computing guarantees.
items.reason_zh: Privasys Enclave OS TDX/GPU 证明机制省略了活动会话绑定，破坏了机密计算的安全保障。

items.reason_en: SGX runtime certificate path flaw in Privasys Enclave OS Mini compromises enclave isolation and security.
items.reason_zh: Privasys Enclave OS Mini 中 SGX 运行时证书路径缺陷破坏了隔离区的隔离性与安全性。

items.reason_en: CVSS 10 unauthenticated RCE via crafted regular expressions in GitLab directly threatens core platform stability and multi-tenant isolation.
items.reason_zh: GitLab中利用构造正则表达式触发的CVSS 10分未授权远程代码执行（RCE）直接威胁核心平台稳定性与多租户隔离性。

items.reason_en: OAuth2 SSRF in SAP Cloud SDK for Python enables tenant subdomain manipulation to exfiltrate client credentials in multi-tenant BTP environments.
items.reason_zh: SAP Cloud SDK for Python中的OAuth2服务端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞允许操纵租户子域名，进而在多租户BTP环境中窃取客户端凭证。

items.reason_en: Race condition during parallel Podman/Buildah builds enables container breakout and host filesystem enumeration, undermining cloud-native security boundaries.
items.reason_zh: 并行Podman/Buildah构建过程中的竞态条件可导致容器逃逸及主机文件系统枚举，破坏云原生安全边界。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in DNS Server enables remote code execution, threatening critical network resolution infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server中的基于堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可被用于远程代码执行，威胁关键网络解析基础设施。

items.reason_en: Critical heap overflow in Microsoft QUIC implementation allows remote code execution over the network, impacting modern TLS/HTTP3 stacks.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft QUIC实现中的严重堆溢出漏洞允许通过网络进行远程代码执行，影响现代TLS/HTTP3协议栈。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in OpenSSH for Windows permits remote code execution, compromising secure shell access on Windows servers.
items.reason_zh: Windows版OpenSSH中的释放后使用（UAF）漏洞允许远程代码执行，危及Windows服务器的安全Shell访问。

items.reason_en: Improper cryptographic signature verification in Windows Schannel enables man-in-the-middle spoofing attacks across network communications.
items.reason_zh: Windows Schannel中不正确的加密签名验证机制可导致网络通信中的中间人欺骗攻击。

items.reason_en: Deadlock in Windows Routing and Remote Access Service (RRAS) allows denial of service against critical network routing functions.
items.reason_zh: Windows路由和远程访问服务（RRAS）中的死锁问题可导致针对关键网络路由功能的拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Argument parsing vulnerability in OpenVPN allows remote command execution via malicious certificate subjects, directly compromising VPN infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: OpenVPN中的参数解析漏洞允许通过恶意证书主题字段实现远程命令执行，直接危及VPN基础设施。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Network Policy Server enables unauthenticated remote code execution, threatening network access control mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: Network Policy Server中的基于堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现未授权远程代码执行，威胁网络访问控制机制。

items.reason_en: Resource management deficiency in Windows SMB Server can be leveraged for remote denial-of-service attacks against critical file sharing services.
items.reason_zh: Windows SMB Server中的资源管理缺陷可被利用于对关键文件共享服务发起远程拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in the DNS Server service permits remote code execution, directly compromising critical network infrastructure and enabling widespread lateral movement within enterprise networks.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server服务中的不受信任指针解引用漏洞允许远程代码执行，直接危及关键网络基础设施，并支持在企业网络内进行广泛的横向移动。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution flaw in the Routing and Remote Access Service (RRAS) allows unauthorized network access, severely impacting perimeter security, VPN reliability, and internal routing integrity.
items.reason_zh: 路由和远程访问服务（RRAS）中的远程代码执行漏洞允许未经授权的网络访问，严重影响边界安全、VPN可靠性及内部路由完整性。

items.reason_en: Type confusion in the DNS Server component allows network-based code execution, directly threatening critical name resolution infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server组件中的类型混淆漏洞允许基于网络的代码执行，直接威胁关键名称解析基础设施。

items.reason_en: A use-after-free vulnerability in the Remote Desktop Gateway Service enables unauthenticated remote code execution over the network.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Gateway Service中的释放后使用漏洞允许通过网络进行未授权远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: A heap-based buffer overflow in OpenSSH for Windows permits unauthenticated network code execution, compromising secure administrative access.
items.reason_zh: Windows版OpenSSH中的基于堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未授权的网络代码执行，危及安全的管理员访问权限。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free flaws in the Windows iSCSI stack allow unauthorized network attackers to execute code, disrupting storage area networks.
items.reason_zh: Windows iSCSI协议栈中的释放后使用漏洞允许未经授权的远程攻击者执行代码，破坏存储区域网络（SAN）。

items.reason_en: A use-after-free vulnerability in the Secure Socket Tunneling Protocol (SSTP) enables unauthenticated network code execution, weakening VPN security.
items.reason_zh: Secure Socket Tunneling Protocol (SSTP)中的释放后使用漏洞允许未授权的网络代码执行，削弱VPN安全性。

items.reason_en: High-severity use-after-free in iSCSI allows unauthorized remote code execution over a network, critically endangering storage area network infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: iSCSI中的高危释放后使用漏洞允许通过网络进行未授权远程代码执行，严重危及存储区域网络基础设施。

items.reason_en: DNS Server use-after-free enables remote code execution without authentication, threatening fundamental network resolution and directory services.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server的释放后使用漏洞可实现无需认证的远程代码执行，威胁基础网络解析与目录服务。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in DHCP Server permits remote code execution, jeopardizing dynamic IP assignment and network configuration reliability.
items.reason_zh: DHCP Server中的越界写入漏洞允许远程代码执行，危及动态IP分配及网络配置的可靠性。

items.reason_en: Resource exhaustion flaw in SMB Server allows unauthenticated denial of service, disrupting file sharing and enterprise workflow dependencies.
items.reason_zh: SMB Server中的资源耗尽漏洞允许未授权拒绝服务攻击，破坏文件共享及企业工作流依赖关系。

items.reason_en: OpenVPN authentication bypass via a crafted certificate subject field compromises remote access security. Attackers can impersonate legitimate users without valid credentials.
items.reason_zh: 通过构造证书主题字段绕过OpenVPN认证机制，危及远程访问安全。攻击者可在无有效凭证的情况下冒充合法用户。

items.reason_en: Null pointer dereference in Libreswan's PKCS#7 handling crashes IKE certificate authentication flows. This impacts IPsec tunnel reliability and availability for secure site-to-site connections.
items.reason_zh: Libreswan处理PKCS#7时的空指针解引用会导致IKE证书认证流程崩溃，影响IPsec隧道的可靠性及站点到站点安全连接的可用性。

items.reason_en: TOZED X300's IPPingDiagnostics handler is vulnerable to OS command injection via a manipulated Host argument, enabling remote attackers to fully compromise network infrastructure equipment.
items.reason_zh: TOZED X300的IPPingDiagnostics处理器存在操作系统命令注入漏洞，可通过篡改Host参数实现，使远程攻击者能够完全控制网络设备。

items.reason_en: Nginx UI's MCP configuration interface permits authenticated users to write and apply restricted directives that bypass the standard HTTP API, increasing the attack surface for web server management planes.
items.reason_zh: Nginx UI的MCP配置接口允许已认证用户写入并应用可绕过标准HTTP API的受限指令，扩大了Web服务器管理平面的攻击面。

items.reason_en: Remote Attestation TLS Clients accept quote ReportData bound only to certificate keys and client nonces, failing to bind it to the active TLS session and undermining secure device attestation flows.
items.reason_zh: Remote Attestation TLS客户端仅接受绑定至证书密钥和客户端随机数的quote ReportData，未能将其绑定至当前TLS会话，破坏了安全的设备证明流程。

items.reason_en: Symlink resolution flaw in Citrix UniconOS enables unauthorized file access or configuration tampering on network appliances.
items.reason_zh: Citrix UniconOS中的符号链接解析缺陷可导致网络设备上的未授权文件访问或配置篡改。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication on critical functions allows unauthenticated actors to create or modify trusted site configurations in Ivanti Xtraction.
items.reason_zh: Ivanti Xtraction中关键功能缺失身份验证，允许未授权实体创建或修改受信任站点配置。

items.reason_en: Authenticated path traversal in template export functionality exposes sensitive internal files on network management platforms.
items.reason_zh: 模板导出功能中的已认证路径遍历漏洞会暴露网络管理平台上的敏感内部文件。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in FortiSIEM allows attackers to write arbitrary files via specially crafted packets. Successful exploitation can lead to unauthorized code execution, log tampering, or complete appliance compromise.
items.reason_zh: FortiSIEM中的路径遍历漏洞允许攻击者通过特制数据包写入任意文件。成功利用可导致未授权代码执行、日志篡改或设备完全沦陷。

items.reason_en: Insufficient input validation in the website blocking feature allows network-adjacent attackers to execute unauthorized router commands. This compromises firewall policies and exposes internal network segmentation to lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: 网站阻止功能中存在的输入验证不足问题，允许网络邻近攻击者执行未授权的路由器命令。这将破坏防火墙策略，并使内部网络分段暴露于横向移动风险之下。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in the CGI execution component allows remote attackers to bypass login mechanisms entirely. Full administrative control over the router can be gained without valid credentials.
items.reason_zh: CGI执行组件中的身份验证缺陷允许远程攻击者完全绕过登录机制。无需有效凭据即可获取路由器的完整管理控制权。

items.reason_en: Request smuggling arises from improper enforcement of Transfer-Encoding header parsing in Squid cache. Attackers can split HTTP requests to bypass backend security controls or poison caches with malicious content.
items.reason_zh: Squid缓存中因未正确执行Transfer-Encoding头部解析导致请求走私漏洞。攻击者可拆分HTTP请求以绕过后端安全控制，或使用恶意内容污染缓存。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in HAProxy Data Plane API improperly drops security controls across multiple transport types, compromising management planes.
items.reason_zh: HAProxy Data Plane API中的身份验证绕过漏洞会导致跨多种传输类型的安全控制被错误丢弃，从而危及管理平面。

items.reason_en: WinBox authentication flow flaw in MikroTik RouterOS allows low-privilege users to steal authorization policies.
items.reason_zh: MikroTik RouterOS中WinBox认证流程存在缺陷，允许低权限用户窃取授权策略。

items.reason_en: Firmware upload filename validation flaw in Siemens RUGGEDCOM switches enables SQL injection.
items.reason_zh: Siemens RUGGEDCOM交换机固件上传文件名验证缺陷可导致SQL注入。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in TRENDnet TEW-432BRP TCP/IP setup form allows remote exploitation.
items.reason_zh: TRENDnet TEW-432BRP的TCP/IP设置表单中存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可被远程利用。

items.reason_en: Custom file label input validation flaw in Siemens RUGGEDCOM devices permits SQL injection attacks.
items.reason_zh: Siemens RUGGEDCOM设备自定义文件标签输入验证缺陷允许SQL注入攻击。

items.reason_en: Bulk export workflow sanitization flaw in Siemens RUGGEDCOM enables SQL injection during device management.
items.reason_zh: Siemens RUGGEDCOM批量导出工作流数据过滤缺陷可在设备管理期间引发SQL注入。

items.reason_en: Remote command injection in Teltonika RUTOS backup functionality allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary commands on routers and IoT gateways.
items.reason_zh: Teltonika RUTOS备份功能中存在远程命令注入漏洞，允许已认证攻击者在路由器和IoT网关上执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9 remote OS command injection via VPN upload CGI exposes network infrastructure to immediate exploitation by external threat actors.
items.reason_zh: 通过VPN上传CGI存在的CVSS评分为9的远程操作系统命令注入漏洞，使网络基础设施面临外部威胁行为体立即利用的风险。

items.reason_en: Privilege escalation in Inductive Automation Ignition Perspective module allows authenticated users to gain unauthorized Designer-level access to industrial projects.
items.reason_zh: Inductive Automation Ignition Perspective模块中的权限提升漏洞允许已认证用户未经授权获取工业项目的Designer级别访问权限。

items.reason_en: Zephyr RTOS contains an out-of-bound write vulnerability that can trigger arbitrary code execution or crashes even on devices with memory protection, threatening safety-critical industrial systems.
items.reason_zh: Zephyr RTOS存在越界写入漏洞，即使在配备内存保护的设备上也可能触发任意代码执行或系统崩溃，对安全关键型工业系统构成威胁。

items.reason_en: The dns_copy_qname function in Zephyr RTOS performs an unchecked memcpy operation on untrusted fields, risking memory corruption in networked industrial controllers and PLCs.
items.reason_zh: Zephyr RTOS中的dns_copy_qname函数在未信任字段上执行未检查的memcpy操作，可能导致联网工业控制器和PLC发生内存损坏。

items.reason_en: Lack of input validation in Zephyr RTOS allows malicious or malformed packets to cause out-of-bounds reads, potentially leaking sensitive operational data or destabilizing control loops.
items.reason_zh: Zephyr RTOS缺乏输入验证，恶意或畸形数据包可导致越界读取，可能泄露敏感运行数据或破坏控制回路稳定性。

items.reason_en: Critical authentication bypass in Ivanti ICS enables remote unauthenticated command execution and is actively exploited in the wild.
items.reason_zh: Ivanti ICS中存在严重的身份验证绕过漏洞，可实现远程未认证命令执行，且已在野外被实际利用。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in the unconnected explicit messaging path allows remote attackers to trigger crashes in EtherNet/IP implementations. This can disrupt critical industrial controller communications and cause operational downtime.
items.reason_zh: 未连接显式消息路径中的越界读取漏洞允许远程攻击者触发EtherNet/IP实现崩溃。这可能中断关键工业控制器通信并导致运营停机。

items.reason_en: Expired pointer dereference in Common Packet Format handling logic enables remote denial of service attacks. Compromised industrial networking equipment may become unresponsive, halting manufacturing or utility operations.
items.reason_zh: Common Packet Format处理逻辑中的过期指针解引用漏洞可导致远程拒绝服务攻击。受影响的工业网络设备可能失去响应，导致制造或公用事业运营中断。

items.reason_en: Insufficient firmware authenticity verification enables attackers to upload modified firmware during authorized updates, compromising building automation systems.
items.reason_zh: 固件真实性验证不足使攻击者能够在授权更新期间上传修改后的固件，从而危及楼宇自动化系统。

items.reason_en: Imported trace files containing executable content enable social engineering attacks for full system compromise.
items.reason_zh: 包含可执行内容的导入跟踪文件可用于社会工程学攻击，以实现系统完全沦陷。

items.reason_en: Unsanitized visual marker data in CSV trace files enables stored XSS via targeted social engineering.
items.reason_zh: CSV跟踪文件中未过滤的视觉标记数据可通过定向社会工程学引发存储型XSS攻击。

items.reason_en: Unsanitized comment fields in CSV trace files enable stored XSS attacks against diagnostic personnel.
items.reason_zh: CSV跟踪文件中未过滤的注释字段可对诊断人员发起存储型XSS攻击。

items.reason_en: Ticket download filename validation flaw in Siemens SIMATIC S7 API allows overwriting critical application files.
items.reason_zh: Siemens SIMATIC S7 API工单下载文件名验证缺陷允许覆盖关键应用程序文件。

items.reason_en: Missing TLS server certificate validation in Siemens Industrial Edge enables man-in-the-middle attacks.
items.reason_zh: Siemens Industrial Edge缺失TLS服务器证书验证可导致中间人攻击。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.9 unrestricted access to internal APIs for authenticated users enables sensitive data exposure and potential system takeover in Siemens SCADA environments.
items.reason_zh: 在Siemens SCADA环境中，已认证用户对内部API拥有CVSS评分为8.9的无限制访问权限，可导致敏感数据泄露及潜在的系统接管。

items.reason_en: Insufficient database role permissions in SIMATIC WinCC could allow lateral movement and unauthorized modification of critical industrial process configurations.
items.reason_zh: SIMATIC WinCC中数据库角色权限不足可能导致横向移动及未经授权的工业关键工艺配置修改。

items.reason_en: Flaw in the containers/image library allows path traversal and unexpected authenticated registry accesses, compromising container image distribution pipelines.
items.reason_zh: containers/image库中的缺陷允许路径遍历及意外的已认证注册表访问，危及容器镜像分发流水线。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables remote code execution via web-delivered payloads.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint中对未信任数据的反序列化漏洞可通过Web交付的有效载荷实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Path equivalence resolution flaw in WebDAV allows privilege escalation over the network, affecting file sharing and collaboration services.
items.reason_zh: WebDAV中的路径等价解析缺陷允许通过网络进行权限提升，影响文件共享与协作服务。

items.reason_en: Double free vulnerability in Internet Information Services (IIS) can trigger remote denial of service against web hosting environments.
items.reason_zh: Internet Information Services (IIS)中的双重释放漏洞可导致针对Web托管环境的远程拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Code injection vulnerability in ASP.NET Core allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code over the network.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core中的代码注入漏洞允许未经身份验证的攻击者通过网络执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Cryptographic signature verification bypass in .NET undermines application integrity checks and enables security feature evasion.
items.reason_zh: .NET中的密码学签名验证绕过削弱了应用程序完整性检查，并可实现安全功能规避。

items.reason_en: HTTP request/response smuggling in ASP.NET Core enables request tampering and cache poisoning attacks, undermining web application integrity, session handling, and user trust across modern web platforms.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core中的HTTP请求/响应走私漏洞可启用请求篡改和缓存投毒攻击，破坏现代Web平台上的应用程序完整性、会话处理及用户信任。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting vulnerability in Microsoft Exchange Server facilitates large-scale phishing and credential theft campaigns, directly impacting enterprise email security and user productivity.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server中的跨站脚本漏洞助长大规模网络钓鱼和凭据窃取活动，直接影响企业邮件安全和用户生产力。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Office SharePoint (CVSS 8.1) enables attackers to perform spoofing and credential theft against web-facing users.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint中的跨站脚本漏洞（CVSS 8.1）使攻击者能够针对面向Web的用户实施欺骗和凭据窃取。

items.reason_en: HTTP request/response smuggling in ASP.NET Core allows security feature bypasses. This protocol-level ambiguity can facilitate unauthorized access or cache poisoning attacks.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core中的HTTP请求/响应走私漏洞可导致安全功能被绕过。这种协议层面的歧义可能促成未授权访问或缓存投毒攻击。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SharePoint enables remote code execution. Insecure object instantiation remains a critical threat to enterprise web portals and document management systems.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint中对不受信任数据的反序列化可导致远程代码执行。不安全的对象实例化仍是企业Web门户和文档管理系统的关键威胁。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in SharePoint allows authorized users to escalate privileges over the network. Database manipulation can lead to data exfiltration or complete system takeover.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint中的SQL注入漏洞允许授权用户通过网络提升权限。数据库操纵可能导致数据外泄或系统完全沦陷。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in SharePoint enables privilege escalation over the network. SSRF can be leveraged to probe internal networks and access restricted backend resources.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint中的服务器端请求伪造漏洞允许通过网络提升权限。SSRF可用于探测内部网络并访问受限的后端资源。

items.reason_en: Weak authentication in Exchange Server allows privilege escalation over the network. Compromised email infrastructure poses severe risks for credential theft and lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server中的弱身份验证漏洞允许通过网络提升权限。受损的邮件基础设施对凭据窃取和横向移动构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in ASP.NET Core allows privilege escalation over the network. Authentication bypasses directly undermine application security controls and session management.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core中的身份验证不当漏洞允许通过网络提升权限。身份验证绕过直接破坏了应用程序的安全控制和会话管理。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in SharePoint allows privilege escalation over the network. Lack of proper access checks exposes sensitive organizational data to unauthorized users.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint中缺失的授权机制允许通过网络提升权限。缺乏适当的访问检查会使敏感的组织数据暴露给未授权用户。

items.reason_en: Race condition in ASP.NET Core allows privilege escalation over the network. Concurrent execution flaws can bypass security checks and destabilize web application logic.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core中的竞争条件漏洞允许通过网络提升权限。并发执行缺陷可绕过安全检查并破坏Web应用程序逻辑的稳定性。

items.reason_en: A stack-based buffer overflow in Internet Information Services (IIS) enables unauthenticated remote code execution, making it a prime target for web server exploitation.
items.reason_zh: Internet Information Services (IIS)中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现未经身份验证的远程代码执行，使其成为Web服务器利用的首要目标。

items.reason_en: Unsafe deserialization of untrusted data in the .NET framework allows unauthenticated network code execution, widely exploited in modern web applications.
items.reason_zh: .NET框架中对不受信任数据的不安全反序列化可导致未经身份验证的网络代码执行，在现代Web应用中被广泛利用。

items.reason_en: A heap-based buffer overflow in WebDAV enables network-based privilege escalation, targeting common file synchronization and collaboration protocols.
items.reason_zh: WebDAV中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现基于网络的权限提升，主要针对常见的文件同步与协作协议。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows network-based code execution, exposing enterprise document management and intranet portals to compromise.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint中的路径遍历漏洞可实现基于网络的代码执行，使企业文档管理和内部门户面临被攻破的风险。

items.reason_en: Improper cryptographic signature verification in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows privilege escalation over the network. Flawed signature checks undermine web application trust and authorization controls.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint中的密码学签名验证不当漏洞允许通过网络提升权限。有缺陷的签名检查会破坏Web应用程序的信任机制和授权控制。

items.reason_en: Path traversal vulnerability in Dynamics Business Central enables privilege escalation over the network. Enterprise web portals using this platform are exposed to unauthorized directory access and data exfiltration.
items.reason_zh: Dynamics Business Central中的路径遍历漏洞允许通过网络提升权限。使用该平台的企业Web门户易受未授权目录访问和数据外泄威胁。

items.reason_en: Adobe ColdFusion suffers from a critical code injection vulnerability that allows arbitrary code execution without user interaction, posing an immediate risk to enterprise web applications.
items.reason_zh: Adobe ColdFusion存在关键代码注入漏洞，可在无需用户交互的情况下执行任意代码，对企业Web应用构成即时风险。

items.reason_en: ColdFusion's unrestricted file upload with dangerous types enables immediate remote code execution, bypassing traditional web application firewalls and security controls.
items.reason_zh: ColdFusion中无限制的危险类型文件上传可导致立即远程代码执行，从而绕过传统的Web应用防火墙和安全控制。

items.reason_en: Qexo blog editor exposes an initialization API endpoint without authentication or setup completion guards, allowing unauthenticated attackers to perform first-time setup and fully take over instances.
items.reason_zh: Qexo博客编辑器暴露了一个初始化API端点，且缺乏身份验证或安装完成防护，允许未经身份验证的攻击者执行首次设置并完全接管实例。

items.reason_en: Easy!Appointments authorization bypass lets unauthenticated attackers modify any appointment by exploiting sequential ID enumeration and missing hash validation in the registration flow.
items.reason_zh: Easy!Appointments的授权绕过漏洞使未经身份验证的攻击者能够通过利用注册流程中的连续ID枚举和缺失的哈希验证来修改任何预约。

items.reason_en: Misskey displays RSS feed item links without verifying URL schemes, enabling attackers controlling feed content to inject unsafe-scheme links for phishing or cross-site scripting attacks.
items.reason_zh: Misskey在未验证URL协议的情况下显示RSS订阅源项目链接，使控制订阅源内容的攻击者能够注入不安全协议的链接以进行网络钓鱼或跨站脚本攻击。

items.reason_en: Critical authorization flaw in Adobe Experience Manager enables unauthenticated remote code execution on enterprise web platforms.
items.reason_zh: Adobe Experience Manager中的关键授权缺陷可在企业Web平台上实现未经身份验证的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Template engine injection in Adobe Commerce allows unauthenticated remote code execution, threatening e-commerce infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Adobe Commerce中的模板引擎注入漏洞允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行，威胁电子商务基础设施。

items.reason_en: Code injection during application installation combined with SQL issues enables complete web application compromise.
items.reason_zh: 应用程序安装期间的代码注入结合SQL问题可导致Web应用被完全攻破。

items.reason_en: Improper input validation in Adobe Experience Manager allows high-privilege attackers to execute arbitrary code without user interaction.
items.reason_zh: Adobe Experience Manager中的输入验证不当漏洞允许高权限攻击者在无需用户交互的情况下执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in Adobe Commerce leads to arbitrary code execution without user interaction. Attackers can fully compromise e-commerce storefronts, stealing customer data or defacing sites.
items.reason_zh: Adobe Commerce中的授权不正确可导致无需用户交互即可执行任意代码。攻击者可完全攻破电商前台，窃取客户数据或篡改网站页面。

items.reason_en: Twig sandbox bypass allows non-admin users to invoke PHP callables like passthru through template operators. This results in remote code execution within web applications that rely on Craft CMS for templating.
items.reason_zh: Twig沙箱绕过允许非管理员用户通过模板操作符调用如passthru之类的PHP可调用函数。这会导致依赖Craft CMS进行模板渲染的Web应用程序发生远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass via forged unsigned session cookies enables attackers to obtain victim session tokens. Identity provider platforms using ZITADEL face severe impersonation risks across integrated web services.
items.reason_zh: 通过伪造未签名的会话Cookie可实现身份验证绕过，使攻击者能够获取受害者的会话令牌。使用ZITADEL的身份提供商平台在集成的Web服务中面临严重的冒充风险。

items.reason_en: RSA public-key text is misclassified as an HMAC secret when non-whitespace precedes the PEM header. Attackers can forge valid JWTs, completely bypassing authentication and authorization in modern web APIs.
items.reason_zh: 当PEM头部前存在非空白字符时，RSA公钥文本会被错误分类为HMAC密钥。攻击者可伪造有效的JWT，从而完全绕过现代Web API的身份验证与授权机制。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in the Grav Login plugin allows attackers to circumvent two-factor authentication by manipulating remember-me cookies.
items.reason_zh: Grav Login插件中的身份验证绕过漏洞允许攻击者通过操纵“记住我”Cookie来规避双因素认证。

items.reason_en: Weak authentication on Nginx UI config routes allows unauthorized modification of web server configurations.
items.reason_zh: Nginx UI配置路由的身份验证机制薄弱，可导致未经授权的Web服务器配置修改。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in phpMyFAQ occurs due to improper escaping when MySQL runs in NO_BACKSLASH_ESCAPES mode.
items.reason_zh: phpMyFAQ中存在SQL注入漏洞，原因是MySQL运行于NO_BACKSLASH_ESCAPES模式时转义处理不当。

items.reason_en: Stored XSS in Froxlor allows authenticated users to inject JavaScript executed by administrators.
items.reason_zh: Froxlor中存在存储型XSS漏洞，允许已认证用户注入由管理员执行的JavaScript代码。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated cross-site scripting in IBM Security Verify Access Web UI alters intended functionality.
items.reason_zh: IBM Security Verify Access Web UI中存在未认证跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞，会改变预期功能。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated path traversal in Dayforce ESS Excelity file downloads exposes sensitive local files.
items.reason_zh: Dayforce ESS Excelity文件下载功能中存在未认证路径遍历漏洞，可导致敏感本地文件泄露。

items.reason_en: Time-based blind SQL injection in Dayforce password recovery functionality enables data exfiltration.
items.reason_zh: Dayforce密码恢复功能中存在基于时间的盲注SQL注入漏洞，可导致数据外泄。

items.reason_en: Authenticated SQL injection in Payload CMS via improperly neutralized query parameters.
items.reason_zh: Payload CMS中因查询参数未正确过滤而存在已认证SQL注入漏洞。

items.reason_en: Admin preview route in TinaCMS allows off-origin iframe URLs, facilitating phishing and XSS attacks.
items.reason_zh: TinaCMS的管理员预览路由允许加载非同源iframe URL，助长钓鱼和XSS攻击。

items.reason_en: Missing CSRF protection on Lektor admin API enables unauthenticated state-changing cross-origin requests.
items.reason_zh: Lektor管理API缺少CSRF防护，可导致未认证的状态变更跨域请求。

items.reason_en: Permissive CORS configuration in Red Hat RESTEasy reflects origins with credentials, enabling credential theft.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat RESTEasy的宽松CORS配置会回显携带凭据的请求来源，从而导致凭据窃取。

items.reason_en: CVSS 10 remote code inclusion in a widely deployed WordPress backup plugin allows complete website takeover and backend persistence.
items.reason_zh: 广泛部署的WordPress备份插件中存在CVSS评分为10的远程代码包含漏洞，可导致网站被完全接管及后端持久化控制。

items.reason_en: Client-side enforcement of server-side security in the Biletiva Ticketing Platform allows state manipulation, bypassing critical transaction validations.
items.reason_zh: Biletiva票务平台将服务端安全策略交由客户端强制执行，导致状态可被篡改，从而绕过关键交易验证。

items.reason_en: Stored XSS via the notification_content parameter in WordPress Bit Integration compromises end-user browsers in automated marketing and CRM workflows.
items.reason_zh: WordPress Bit Integration插件中通过notification_content参数存在存储型XSS漏洞，可在自动化营销和CRM工作流中危害终端用户浏览器。

items.reason_en: Type confusion in .NET and Visual Studio runtime allows privilege escalation over the network, affecting enterprise development and deployment pipelines.
items.reason_zh: .NET和Visual Studio运行时中存在类型混淆漏洞，可导致网络权限提升，影响企业开发与部署流水线。

items.reason_en: Untrusted search path in .NET Framework enables local security feature bypass, potentially leading to DLL hijacking or code execution.
items.reason_zh: .NET Framework中存在不受信任的搜索路径漏洞，可导致本地安全特性被绕过，进而可能引发DLL劫持或代码执行。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in Dynamics Business Central allows authenticated attackers to escalate privileges over the network, impacting ERP systems.
items.reason_zh: Dynamics Business Central中存在路径遍历漏洞，允许已认证攻击者通过网络提升权限，影响ERP系统。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in .NET allows remote code execution, representing a critical risk for any backend services, APIs, or microservices relying on this widely adopted application runtime.
items.reason_zh: .NET中反序列化不可信数据可导致远程代码执行，对依赖该广泛使用的运行时的任何后端服务、API或微服务构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in SQL Server permits remote code execution, threatening database integrity, availability, and potentially exposing highly sensitive organizational data stored within.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server中存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，威胁数据库完整性与可用性，并可能泄露其中存储的高度敏感组织数据。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SQL Server (CVSS 8.8) allows remote code execution, directly jeopardizing enterprise database integrity and confidentiality.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server中反序列化不可信数据（CVSS 8.8）可导致远程代码执行，直接危及企业数据库的完整性与机密性。

items.reason_en: A heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server enables network-based code execution, directly threatening database integrity and confidentiality.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可实现基于网络的代码执行，直接威胁数据库的完整性与机密性。

items.reason_en: Another heap overflow variant in SQL Server allows network-based privilege escalation, requiring immediate patching for database administrators.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server中另一种堆溢出变体可导致基于网络的权限提升，数据库管理员需立即进行补丁修复。

items.reason_en: Improper privilege management in Python allows local privilege escalation, affecting development pipelines and automated middleware deployments.
items.reason_zh: Python中权限管理不当可导致本地权限提升，影响开发流水线及自动化中间件部署。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in SQL Server allows authorized attackers to execute code remotely, risking database integrity, configuration tampering, and data exfiltration.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server中存在堆溢出漏洞，允许已认证攻击者远程执行代码，可能导致数据库完整性受损、配置遭篡改及数据外泄。

items.reason_en: Algorithmic complexity issue in .NET runtime enables unauthenticated denial of service over a network, significantly impacting middleware availability and performance.
items.reason_zh: .NET运行时中存在算法复杂度问题，可导致网络未认证拒绝服务攻击，严重影响中间件的可用性与性能。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in SQL Server allows privilege escalation over the network. Direct exploitation of the database engine threatens data integrity and backend service availability.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server中存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致网络权限提升。直接利用数据库引擎漏洞将威胁数据完整性及后端服务可用性。

items.reason_en: Code injection in Visual Studio Tools for Applications and SSMS permits remote code execution over the network. Database administrators and automated query tools are vulnerable to payload execution.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Tools for Applications和SSMS中存在代码注入漏洞，可导致网络远程代码执行。数据库管理员及自动化查询工具易受载荷执行攻击。

items.reason_en: IBM WebSphere Liberty contains an authentication bypass vulnerability when the SAML feature is enabled, allowing unauthorized access to protected enterprise resources.
items.reason_zh: IBM WebSphere Liberty 在启用 SAML 功能时存在身份验证绕过漏洞，可导致未授权访问受保护的企业资源。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated remote attackers can bypass access controls configured on gRPC service methods in WebSphere Liberty, compromising microservice communication layers.
items.reason_zh: 未经身份验证的远程攻击者可绕过 WebSphere Liberty 中配置的 gRPC 服务方法访问控制，从而破坏微服务通信层安全。

items.reason_en: Improper verification of cryptographic signatures in WebSphere Application Server allows remote attackers to bypass integrity checks and tamper with middleware communications.
items.reason_zh: WebSphere Application Server 中存在密码签名验证不当漏洞，允许远程攻击者绕过完整性检查并篡改中间件通信。

items.reason_en: FrankenPHP worker mode incorrectly retains PHP session state between requests when compiled without HAVE_PHP_SESSION, risking sensitive data leakage across concurrent web requests.
items.reason_zh: FrankenPHP 的 worker 模式在未定义 HAVE_PHP_SESSION 编译选项时，会在请求间错误地保留 PHP 会话状态，导致并发 Web 请求间存在敏感数据泄露风险。

items.reason_en: High-severity HTML injection in Vitess debug endpoints exposes sensitive debugging data and can be leveraged for further attacks.
items.reason_zh: Vitess 调试端点存在高危 HTML 注入漏洞，会暴露敏感调试数据，并可被利用发起后续攻击。

items.reason_en: Double free and use-after-free vulnerabilities in RDB graph decoders allow remote code execution via Redis replication commands. Attackers targeting FalkorDB instances can gain full database server control.
items.reason_zh: RDB 图解码器中存在双重释放（Double free）及释放后使用（Use-after-free）漏洞，可通过 Redis 复制命令实现远程代码执行。针对 FalkorDB 实例的攻击者可获取数据库服务器的完全控制权。

items.reason_en: Incorrect boundary checks in MariaDB's CONNECT engine permit one-byte null writes beyond a stack buffer. This heap corruption flaw can be leveraged for denial of service or potential code execution during table operations.
items.reason_zh: MariaDB 的 CONNECT 引擎存在边界检查不当漏洞，允许在栈缓冲区外写入单字节空字符。该堆内存损坏缺陷可在表操作期间被利用于拒绝服务攻击或潜在代码执行。

items.reason_en: SurrealDB fails to validate caller-selected namespace or database against the authentication level of the session user. This allows cross-tenant data access, violating multi-tenant isolation guarantees in managed database deployments.
items.reason_zh: SurrealDB 未根据会话用户的身份验证级别校验调用者指定的命名空间或数据库，导致可跨租户访问数据，破坏了托管数据库部署中的多租户隔离保障。

items.reason_en: Missing tenant isolation checks in SurrealDB allow authenticated users to switch namespaces and access unauthorized cross-tenant data.
items.reason_zh: SurrealDB 缺失租户隔离检查机制，允许已认证用户切换命名空间并访问未授权的跨租户数据。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in IBM WebSphere Application Server allows administrative impersonation across cells.
items.reason_zh: IBM WebSphere Application Server 存在身份验证绕过漏洞，可实现跨 Cell（单元）的管理员身份冒充。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in databasement allows authenticated users to execute arbitrary system commands.
items.reason_zh: databasement 存在操作系统命令注入漏洞，允许已认证用户执行任意系统命令。

items.reason_en: Sub-request validation flaw in IBM Planning Analytics enables privilege escalation and unauthorized access.
items.reason_zh: IBM Planning Analytics 存在子请求验证缺陷，可导致权限提升与未授权访问。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication checks in IBM Planning Analytics grant unauthorized administrative access.
items.reason_zh: IBM Planning Analytics 存在身份验证检查不当漏洞，可导致未授权的管理员访问。

items.reason_en: Role permission bypass in Vearch ignores read-only levels, allowing unauthorized document modifications.
items.reason_zh: Vearch 存在角色权限绕过漏洞，无视只读权限级别，可导致未授权的文档修改。

items.reason_en: Insufficient input validation in SAP S/4HANA rule scripting enables remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: SAP S/4HANA 规则脚本存在输入验证不足漏洞，可导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Authorization boundary flaw in SAP MII admin functionality allows privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: SAP MII 管理功能存在授权边界缺陷，可导致权限提升。

items.reason_en: Low-privilege attackers can invoke internal operations on remote systems via SAP NetWeaver Visual Composer.
items.reason_zh: 低权限攻击者可通过 SAP NetWeaver Visual Composer 在远程系统上调用内部操作。

items.reason_en: db2locssh enablement flaw in IBM Db2 allows local privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: IBM Db2 存在 db2locssh 启用配置缺陷，可导致本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in IBM Db2 Mirror for i enables malicious code execution and privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: IBM Db2 Mirror for i 存在身份验证绕过漏洞，可导致恶意代码执行与权限提升。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 command injection in Visual Studio Code compromises developer workstations and potentially CI/CD pipelines through malicious extensions or scripts.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 存在 CVSS 评分为 8.8 的命令注入漏洞，攻击者可通过恶意扩展或脚本攻陷开发者工作站，并可能波及 CI/CD 流水线。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.2 out-of-bounds read in Hyper-V exposes virtualization host memory, risking information disclosure and guest-to-host privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: Hyper-V 存在 CVSS 评分为 8.2 的越界读取漏洞，会暴露虚拟化宿主机内存，存在信息泄露及客户机提权至宿主机的风险。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.8 weak authentication in Windows Print Spooler Components facilitates local privilege escalation, a well-known attack vector in enterprise environments.
items.reason_zh: Windows Print Spooler Components 存在 CVSS 评分为 7.8 的身份验证强度不足漏洞，易被利用实现本地权限提升，这是企业环境中常见的攻击向量。

items.reason_en: Memory leak in Remote Desktop Gateway Service enables unauthenticated denial of service, affecting secure remote access infrastructure and user connectivity.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Gateway Service 存在内存泄漏漏洞，可导致未认证拒绝服务攻击，影响安全远程访问基础设施及用户连接。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in HTTP.sys can lead to local code execution, compromising the underlying web server component heavily utilized by IIS and internal services.
items.reason_zh: HTTP.sys 存在越界读取漏洞，可导致本地代码执行，进而危及被 IIS 及内部服务广泛依赖的底层 Web 服务器组件。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in LibRaw image processing library allows remote code execution via crafted files. The library is widely integrated into photography and imaging applications across multiple platforms.
items.reason_zh: LibRaw 图像处理库存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可通过构造文件实现远程代码执行。该库被广泛集成于多平台的摄影与图像处理应用中。

items.reason_en: Improper input validation in Adobe CAI Content Credentials enables security feature bypass without user interaction. This undermines digital content provenance standards and authenticity verification mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: Adobe CAI Content Credentials 存在输入验证不当漏洞，可在无需用户交互的情况下绕过安全功能，破坏了数字内容溯源标准与真实性验证机制。

items.reason_en: Vikunja insecurely links SSO logins to pre-existing local accounts using only email addresses, enabling account hijacking when administrators enable the emailfallback option.
items.reason_zh: Vikunja 仅凭邮箱地址将 SSO 登录与现有本地账户关联，缺乏安全性；当管理员启用 emailfallback 选项时，可导致账户劫持。

items.reason_en: ConvertX uses HTTP GET for permanent file deletion without CSRF protection, allowing attackers to force authenticated users to delete files by visiting malicious pages.
items.reason_zh: ConvertX 使用 HTTP GET 请求执行永久文件删除操作且缺乏 CSRF 防护，攻击者可通过诱导访问恶意页面，强制已认证用户删除文件。

items.reason_en: MultiTail's execute-on-match feature improperly escapes matched input inside double quotes before passing it to the shell, enabling command injection in log monitoring workflows.
items.reason_zh: MultiTail 的 execute-on-match 功能在向 Shell 传递前，未对双引号内的匹配输入进行正确转义，导致日志监控流程中存在命令注入风险。

items.reason_en: Anthropic Claude Code plugin installation runs git checkout without verifying the resulting HEAD equals the pinned commit SHA, introducing supply chain risks in AI-assisted development environments.
items.reason_zh: Anthropic Claude Code 插件安装过程执行 git checkout 时，未验证生成的 HEAD 是否指向固定的 Commit SHA，从而在 AI 辅助开发环境中引入供应链安全风险。

items.reason_en: dataclasses-avroschema improperly quotes namespace values during Python type definition generation, causing downstream schema parsers to fail and breaking data serialization pipelines.
items.reason_zh: dataclasses-avroschema 在生成 Python 类型定义时未正确引用命名空间值，导致下游模式解析器失败并中断数据序列化流水线。

items.reason_en: Indirect prompt injection bypasses shell command restrictions in AI coding assistants, enabling unauthorized system-level operations.
items.reason_zh: 间接提示注入可绕过 AI 编程助手的 Shell 命令限制，从而执行未授权的系统级操作。

items.reason_en: Malicious OpenAPI documents can inject JavaScript into generated TypeScript code, compromising CI/CD pipelines and developer workstations.
items.reason_zh: 恶意 OpenAPI 文档可向生成的 TypeScript 代码中注入 JavaScript，危及 CI/CD 流水线及开发者工作站。

items.reason_en: Parsing discrepancies between tree-sitter and bash allow execution of unauthorized commands in AI-assisted scripting environments.
items.reason_zh: tree-sitter 与 bash 之间的解析差异可导致在 AI 辅助脚本环境中执行未授权命令。

items.reason_en: The gitstatus/install script disables TLS certificate verification and skips SHA-256 integrity checks when utilities are missing. Network-positioned attackers can perform man-in-the-middle attacks to inject malicious scripts into shell environments.
items.reason_zh: gitstatus/install 脚本在缺失依赖工具时会禁用 TLS 证书验证并跳过 SHA-256 完整性检查。处于网络中间位置的攻击者可利用中间人攻击将恶意脚本注入 Shell 环境。

items.reason_en: CBOR decoding trusts declared array and map lengths without validating remaining input bytes. Remote attackers can supply tiny crafted payloads to drive billions of iterations, causing rapid CPU exhaustion and service disruption.
items.reason_zh: CBOR 解码在未验证剩余输入字节的情况下盲目信任声明的数组和映射长度。远程攻击者可提交微小的构造载荷以驱动数十亿次迭代，导致 CPU 迅速耗尽及服务中断。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in the gf_m2ts_decode_ait function can be triggered remotely via malformed media streams. This flaw poses a significant risk to multimedia frameworks and streaming middleware processing AIT metadata.
items.reason_zh: gf_m2ts_decode_ait 函数中的越界写入漏洞可通过畸形媒体流远程触发。该缺陷对处理 AIT 元数据的多媒体框架及流媒体中间件构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated OS command injection in an AI-driven text-to-speech service enables full system compromise without prior access.
items.reason_zh: AI 驱动的文本转语音服务中存在未认证的系统命令注入漏洞，攻击者可在无需先验访问权限的情况下实现系统完全接管。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in libnfs ZDR decoding corrupts memory and may lead to instability or exploitation.
items.reason_zh: libnfs 的 ZDR 解码存在越界写入漏洞，会导致内存损坏，可能引发系统不稳定或被利用。

items.reason_en: Config validator bypass in Wazuh allows injection of root-level commands via case-sensitivity mismatch.
items.reason_zh: Wazuh 的配置验证器绕过漏洞可利用大小写敏感性不匹配注入 root 级命令。

items.reason_en: Cluster worker in Wazuh can overwrite protected master files using a trailing-slash basename bypass.
items.reason_zh: Wazuh 的集群工作节点可利用尾部斜杠基名绕过机制覆盖受保护的 master 文件。

items.reason_en: Revoked administrator tokens remain valid in Wazuh, allowing permanent retention of privileged access.
items.reason_zh: Wazuh 中已吊销的管理员令牌仍保持有效，导致攻击者可永久保留特权访问权限。

items.reason_en: Missing origin check in Wazuh agent upgrade channel enables reading arbitrary files as root.
items.reason_zh: Wazuh 代理升级通道缺少来源校验，可导致以 root 身份读取任意文件。

items.reason_en: Crafted mailbox messages in IBM Power Systems firmware allow reading or modifying Hostboot memory regions.
items.reason_zh: IBM Power Systems 固件中的构造邮箱消息漏洞允许读取或修改 Hostboot 内存区域。

items.reason_en: Maliciously crafted code bypasses boot image validation path in IBM Power Systems firmware.
items.reason_zh: 恶意构造的代码可绕过 IBM Power Systems 固件中的启动镜像验证流程。

items.reason_en: Unvalidated model paths in NLTK bypass containment, allowing JVM file writes and system probing.
items.reason_zh: NLTK 中未经验证的模型路径可绕过隔离机制，允许向 JVM 写入文件并进行系统探测。

items.reason_en: Model download handler in DeepPavlov is vulnerable to path traversal via the untar function.
items.reason_zh: DeepPavlov 的模型下载处理器通过 untar 函数存在路径遍历漏洞。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in NVIDIA DALI may cause information disclosure or denial of service.
items.reason_zh: NVIDIA DALI 中的越界读取漏洞可能导致信息泄露或服务拒绝。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in NVIDIA DALI might lead to denial of service or data tampering.
items.reason_zh: NVIDIA DALI 中的越界写入漏洞可能导致拒绝服务或数据篡改。

items.reason_en: Unsynchronized WebSocket map access in Podgrab causes race condition denial of service.
items.reason_zh: Podgrab 中未同步的 WebSocket 映射访问会引发竞态条件，导致拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Webhook listener in cc-connect accepts unauthenticated updates when secrets are missing.
items.reason_zh: 当 cc-connect 缺失密钥时，其 Webhook 监听器会接受未认证的更新请求。

items.reason_en: Environment tarball handler in SeldonIO MLServer is vulnerable to path traversal during extraction.
items.reason_zh: SeldonIO MLServer 的环境压缩包处理器在解压过程中存在路径遍历漏洞。

items.reason_en: Checkpoint extraction in MosaicML Composer is vulnerable to path traversal via tarball manipulation.
items.reason_zh: MosaicML Composer 的检查点提取功能因压缩包操纵存在路径遍历漏洞。

items.reason_en: XML external entity vulnerability in Commvault CVFS allows sensitive information disclosure.
items.reason_zh: Commvault CVFS 中存在 XML 外部实体（XXE）漏洞，可导致敏感信息泄露。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in Commvault HyperScale MediaAgents exposes sensitive configuration and log files.
items.reason_zh: Commvault HyperScale MediaAgents 中的路径遍历漏洞会暴露敏感配置文件及日志。

items.reason_en: Remote directory traversal in IBM Maximo Application Suite exposes arbitrary system files.
items.reason_zh: IBM Maximo Application Suite 中的远程目录遍历漏洞可暴露任意系统文件。

items.reason_en: Infinite parsing loop in IBM Maximo IoT component causes denial of service.
items.reason_zh: IBM Maximo IoT 组件中的无限解析循环会导致拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Uncontrolled recursion in IBM Maximo AI Service triggers denial of service conditions.
items.reason_zh: IBM Maximo AI Service 中的非受控递归会触发拒绝服务漏洞。

items.reason_en: Uncontrolled resource consumption in IBM Aspera Enterprise WebApps causes denial of service.
items.reason_zh: IBM Aspera Enterprise WebApps 中的资源消耗失控会导致拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Null pointer dereference in yt-dlp-web-ui allows unauthenticated remote denial of service.
items.reason_zh: yt-dlp-web-ui 中的空指针解引用漏洞允许未认证的远程攻击者发起拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Agent card fetching manipulation in conductor-oss risks service disruption and data exposure.
items.reason_zh: conductor-oss 中代理卡获取逻辑的操纵风险可能导致服务中断与数据泄露。

items.reason_en: Double free vulnerability in Red Hat's libarchive RAR5 parser triggers memory corruption during archive extraction, risking application crashes or code execution.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat 的 libarchive RAR5 解析器中存在双重释放漏洞，在解压归档文件时可能触发内存损坏，进而导致应用程序崩溃或代码执行。

items.reason_en: Code injection via preprocessor configuration manipulation in PaddlePaddle AI inference frameworks threatens machine learning pipeline integrity and model loading.
items.reason_zh: 通过篡改预处理器配置在 PaddlePaddle AI 推理框架中注入代码，将威胁机器学习流水线的完整性及模型加载过程。
